plugins.description: LCU (Codex computer use) for DeepSeek Harness: macOS app control with an approval dialog, via an MCP adapter.
plugins.readme_text:
# @kinocode/dsh-lcu

[日本語](README.ja.md) | English

[LCU](https://github.com/amontlabs/lcu) (Codex computer use, decoupled from the Codex app) as a
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin. The agent gets
`mcp__lcu__js` / `mcp__lcu__js_reset` to read and operate native macOS apps.

DSH's stock `dsh-mcp-client` cannot answer LCU's per-app approval requests (MCP *elicitation*), so a plain
MCP mount fails with `createElicitation is unavailable`. This plugin launches LCU behind a small adapter
(`lib/adapter.mjs`) that handles approval.

## Requirements
- macOS (Apple Silicon) with the official **ChatGPT desktop app** installed
- **LCU** installed, e.g. `~/.local/share/lcu` ([installation guide](https://github.com/amontlabs/lcu/blob/main/docs/INSTALLATION.md)); `--runtime-only` is enough
- macOS permissions: Accessibility (ChatGPT Computer Use) and Screen Recording (ChatGPT)

## Install
```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @kinocode/dsh-lcu
```
Restart DSH and start a new session. Other LCU location: set `prefix` (below) or `LCU_PREFIX`.

## Approval modes
Set in your profile patch:
```yaml
- id: lcu
  config:
    approval: ask      # ask (default) | all | deny
```
| `approval` | Behavior |
|---|---|
| `ask` | A macOS dialog asks you: Deny / Allow this time / Always allow (Touch ID, same as `lcu apps allow`). Closed, timed out, or answered faster than a human → denied |
| `all` | Approve every app without asking |
| `deny` | Always deny |

In every mode the adapter refuses apps the agent could use to approve itself: DSH, terminals, Claude,
`osascript` / System Events. Other config: `prefix`, `toolCallTimeoutMs`.

## What the adapter does
- Exposes only `js` and `js_reset` (host-only tools such as `turn_ended` are hidden)
- Saves screenshots as files under `$TMPDIR/dsh-lcu-shots/` and returns the path (view with `read_image`),
  because the MCP client turns images into placeholders
- Reconnects to LCU on the next call if it exits

## Safety
`all` lets the agent operate any app, including browsers and password managers. Prefer `ask`.
This is an unofficial community plugin; it is not affiliated with OpenAI or amontlabs. The ChatGPT app and
its runtime keep their own terms; this package contains neither.

## License
MIT

# dsh-codex-rail

English  |  中文说明

--- ## English Transforms **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** into a sleek, immersive **Codex-style dual-column workspace** with an integrated Activity Bar, unified topbar, and smooth session history navigation. > [!NOTE] > **Author Disclaimer: This project is for personal use by the author and is a product of vibecoding.** > Crafted to bring a sleek, distraction-free, and immersive Codex dual-column workflow to DeepSeek Harness. Feature evolution and maintenance are primarily tailored to the author's daily workflow. Feedback, suggestions, and PRs are warmly welcomed! ### ✨ Key Features - 🎨 **Unified Titlebar & Activity Rail** Seamlessly fuses the native window titlebar with the 48px vertical Activity Rail, eliminating jarring borders, white gaps, and layout seams. - 🗂️ **Codex Dual-Column Layout** - **48px Activity Rail**: Consolidates plugins, web browser, terminal, and workspace switchers into a sleek vertical navigation column; - **Flexible Drawer Panel**: History sessions and side drawers slide smoothly, maximizing your conversation and coding viewport. - 👤 **Quick Account Center & Avatar Access** A dedicated 30px circular crystal avatar entry is pinned at the bottom of the Activity Rail for instant one-click access to account, profile, and model settings. - 🌈 **Wallpaper Engine Seamless Transparency** Deeply integrates with Wallpaper Engine plugins, supporting liquid glass blur, acrylic frosted sidebar, and full transparent mode with zero visual clipping. - ⚡ **Session History Navigation (Forward / Back)** Built-in browser-like navigation buttons with native global shortcuts: Alt + ← (Back) and Alt + → (Forward) to effortlessly traverse multi-turn conversations. - 🪄 **10px Floating Card Workspace** The main chat and coding area is wrapped in a refined floating container with subtle inner shadows and rounded corners for maximum visual depth. - 🚀 **Buttery-Smooth Animations** Optimized CSS transform transitions and GPU repaint boundaries, completely eliminating frame drops during sidebar expand and collapse. ### ⌨️ Keybindings | Shortcut | Description | | :--- | :--- | | Alt + ← | Navigate back to previous session history | | Alt + → | Navigate forward to next session history | | Click Bottom Avatar | Open / focus Account Center & Profile Settings | ### 📦 Installation #### Method 1: DSH Plugin Market (Recommended) 1. Open DeepSeek Harness (DSH); 2. Go to **Plugin Market**; 3. Search for `dsh-codex-rail` and click **Install**; 4. Restart or refresh DSH to enjoy. #### Method 2: Command Line ```bash # In your DSH profile directory (e.g. ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop) npm install dsh-codex-rail ``` And ensure it is enabled in your `cordis.yml`: ```yaml dsh-codex-rail: {} ``` #### Method 3: Local Symlink for Development ```bash git clone https://github.com/ComlaiGonnann/dsh-codex-rail.git # Create Junction on Windows: mklink /J "%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\packages\dsh-codex-rail" "path\to\dsh-codex-rail" ``` ### ⚙️ Compatibility - **Compatible with DSH**: `>= 0.1.1-rc.1` (Full native support for DSH 0.2.0 / 0.2.1-rc.1 / 0.2.1-rc.2 / 0.2.1-rc.3 Desktop & Web) - **Platforms**: Windows / macOS / Linux --- ## 中文说明 将 **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** 界面重构为极具现代质感的 **Codex 式双列活动栏**与**全窗一体化**工作区主题插件。 > [!NOTE] > **作者声明：此为作者自用且为 vibecoding 产物。** > 本插件旨在为 DeepSeek Harness 打造精致沉浸的 Codex 双列活动栏与顶栏一体化视觉体验。功能演变与日常维护主要依据作者个人实际工作流展开，欢迎交流体验与提交 PR！ ### ✨ 核心特性 - 🎨 **全窗顶栏一体化质感** 无缝打通原生标题栏与 48px 活动栏（Activity Rail），彻底消除断层与多余留白，与原生明亮/暗黑主题深度贴合。 - 🗂️ **Codex 级双列工作流** - **48px 图标活动栏**：将插件、终端、浏览器、工作区切换等功能归拢于左侧纵向 Rail，布局井然有序； - **弹性会话面板**：侧边列表支持平滑收展，留出最大化的主对话与编码视野。 - 👤 **快捷账号中心与水晶头像入口** 在活动栏底部常驻 30px 精美圆形水晶微质感头像与个人中心入口，点击即可直接呼出或定位到账号与模型配置。 - 🌈 **壁纸引擎无缝透光与毛玻璃兼容** 深度适配 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸插件，无缝支持液态磨砂毛玻璃（Liquid Glass）、侧边栏亚克力与全透模式（Full Clear）。 - ⚡ **会话前进 / 后退历史导航** 内置导航控制按键，并原生支持 Alt + ←（后退）和 Alt + →（前进）全局快捷键，顺畅穿梭于多轮历史会话。 - 🪄 **工作区 10px 悬浮圆角卡片** 主对话与代码编辑区域采用卡片化容器包裹，搭配轻量内衬阴影与圆角设计，层次分明，极具科技美感。 - 🚀 **丝滑动画与高帧率过渡** 深度优化 CSS Transform 与浏览器重绘机制，彻底解决原生在侧边栏折叠与展开时的掉帧卡顿。 ### ⌨️ 快捷键速查 | 快捷键 | 功能说明 | | :--- | :--- | | Alt + ← | 后退至上一个会话历史 | | Alt + → | 前进至下一个会话历史 | | 点击活动栏底部头像 | 快速唤出 / 跳转个人账号中心 | ### 📦 安装与使用 #### 方式一：DSH 插件市场安装（推荐） 1. 启动 DeepSeek Harness (DSH)； 2. 进入 **插件市场 (Market)**； 3. 搜索 `dsh-codex-rail` 并点击 **安装**； 4. 安装完成后重启或刷新 DSH 即可生效。 #### 方式二：命令行安装 进入你的 DSH 用户 Profile 目录（如 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop` 或指定 workspace）： ```bash npm install dsh-codex-rail ``` 并在 `cordis.yml` 中确认启用： ```yaml dsh-codex-rail: {} ``` #### 方式三：开发者本地软链接调试 ```bash # 克隆仓库 git clone https://github.com/ComlaiGonnann/dsh-codex-rail.git # 在 DSH 的 packages 目录下建立软链接 (Windows 示例) mklink /J "%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\packages\dsh-codex-rail" "你的本地仓库路径\dsh-codex-rail" ``` ### ⚙️ 兼容性说明 - **兼容 DSH 版本**：`>= 0.1.1-rc.1`（完美支持 DSH 0.2.0 / 0.2.1-rc.1 / 0.2.1-rc.2 / 0.2.1-rc.3 Desktop 与 Web） - **适用平台**：Windows / macOS / Linux --- ## 📄 开源许可 / License 本项目基于 [MIT License](./LICENSE) 开源发布。

plugins.description: Codex-style file-based long-term memory for DSH: two-stage extraction, consolidated MEMORY.md handbook, prompt-injected summary, and search/read/list/note tools.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-codex-memories

Codex-style **long-term memory** for DSH: cross-session memory that ingests finished sessions, consolidates them into a searchable handbook, and injects a compact summary before every turn.

It reproduces the two-stage structure of the Codex memory system rather than approximating it: per-session extraction first, then a consolidation pass over many raw memories.

## Why

DSH sessions are isolated by default. A correction you made yesterday, a command that only works in one repo, a symptom/cause/fix you already paid for — none of it carries over unless you restate it. This plugin makes the agent remember:

- how you want it to work, without being told twice
- where the truth lives in a specific repo, and which commands actually run
- which failure has which fix

## How it works

```
session goes idle for N seconds
   └─ Stage 1  one model call per session -> session_summaries/<slug>.md + raw_memories.md
        └─ Stage 2  once enough memory accumulates -> MEMORY.md + memory_summary.md
             └─ before each turn, memory_summary.md is injected into the prompt
```

All durable artifacts are plain Markdown you can read, edit, version, or move. `index.json` holds the extraction cache, job records, and the consolidation watermark.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @lushdawn/dsh-codex-memories
```

Local development:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add link:<absolute path to this directory>
```

Restart DSH, or let a live profile hot-load it.

## Commands

| Command | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `/memory status` | memory root, extracted sessions, pending consolidation, last timestamps |
| `/memory show` | print the current `memory_summary.md` |
| `/memory extract` | extract the current session immediately |
| `/memory backfill` | scan stored sessions and extract the ones never processed |
| `/memory consolidate` | merge pending memory into `MEMORY.md` now |
| `/memory forget <sessionId\|all>` | drop extraction records (handbook content is kept) |
| `/memory on` / `off` | toggle automatic extraction for this process |

## Tools

Exposed to the model when `dedicatedTools` is on:

| Tool | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `memory_search` | line-level keyword search across memory files (`any` / `all` / `on_same_line`) |
| `memory_read` | read one memory file by line range |
| `memory_list` | inventory of the memory folder and pending work |
| `memory_note` | append one ad-hoc note — the only write path the model is offered |

The model is instructed to cite memory as `MEMORY.md:12-14|note=[...]`.

## Configuration

Every field has a safe default; override in your profile patch:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-codex-memories
      name: dsh-codex-memories
      config:
        storageDir: ''            # default $DSH_HOME/memories
        generate: true
        use: true
        dedicatedTools: true
        model: ''                 # e.g. deepseek-official/deepseek-flash
        extractModel: ''          # falls back to model
        consolidationModel: ''    # falls back to model
        idleSeconds: 120
        maxSessionsPerRun: 3
        maxSessionAgeDays: 30
        consolidationThreshold: 2
        maxInjectChars: 9000
        minSessionMessages: 4
        extractMaxTokens: 8000
        consolidateMaxTokens: 16000
```

When `model` is empty the plugin reads the current default model, then falls back to `deepseek-official/deepseek-flash`.

## Data layout

```
$DSH_HOME/memories/
├── MEMORY.md                    # durable handbook, Task Group organized
├── memory_summary.md            # prompt-loaded layer; first line must be v1
├── raw_memories.md              # mechanical stage-1 merge, ascending session id
├── session_summaries/<slug>.md  # one structured recap per session
├── extensions/ad_hoc/notes/     # notes written by you or the model
└── index.json                   # extraction cache, job records, watermark
```

## Cost and privacy

- **It spends tokens**: one Stage-1 call per session and one Stage-2 call per consolidation. Sessions under 4 messages are skipped; at most 3 sessions are processed per sweep.
- **Local files only**: no network access beyond the model API it calls.
- **It enters your prompt**: `memory_summary.md` is injected every turn, which is why it is capped by `maxInjectChars`.
- **Auditable**: every artifact is readable Markdown.
- **The model cannot rewrite the handbook**: it may only append ad-hoc notes; consolidation is a separate pass, so one turn cannot corrupt durable memory.

## Fidelity to Codex

The behavioral spec comes from reverse engineering Codex itself — the on-disk shape under `~/.codex/memories` plus the prompt templates embedded in `codex.exe`:

| Codex | dsh-codex-memories |
| --- | --- |
| `~/.codex/memories/` | `$DSH_HOME/memories/` |
| `MEMORY.md` / `memory_summary.md` / `raw_memories.md` | same names, same formats |
| `rollout_summaries/*.md` | `session_summaries/*.md` |
| `memories_1.sqlite` | `index.json` |
| Stage 1 extraction prompt | `PHASE1_TEMPLATE` in `lib/prompts.js` |
| Phase 2 consolidation prompt | `PHASE2_TEMPLATE` in `lib/prompts.js` |
| usage guidance + citation format | `USAGE_TEMPLATE` in `lib/prompts.js` |
| rollout scan backfill | `/memory backfill` + boot sweep |

See [docs/mechanism.md](docs/mechanism.md) for the full mechanism and the evidence behind it.

## Known limits

- Stage 2 asks for two complete documents in one reply. On a very large handbook the reply can hit the output cap; the old files are then kept and the pass reports an error instead of writing something corrupt.
- Automatic extraction needs the process alive during the idle window; otherwise the next boot's `backfill` catches up.
- Retrieval is keyword/line based, not semantic — the same tradeoff Codex makes. Route with `keywords` in `MEMORY.md`.

## Contributing

Issues and pull requests are welcome — see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). For anything
security-related, follow [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) instead of opening a public issue. Release
history lives in [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md).

## License

MIT

plugins.description: DSH Desktop plugin: hold Ctrl and tap Tab to switch between recently viewed sessions; release the modifier to open the highlighted one. Ctrl+Shift+Tab cycles backwards.
plugins.readme_text:
# Session Switcher

English overview below · 完整详细文档为简体中文，见 [中文说明](#中文说明)

Session Switcher (`dsh-session-switcher`) is a plugin for **DSH Desktop** that brings hold-to-switch navigation to your recently viewed sessions. Hold `Ctrl` and tap `Tab` to open a floating list of recent sessions with the next target highlighted; tap `Tab` again to move down, then release the modifier(s) to open the highlighted session (`Ctrl+Shift+Tab` moves backwards and `Esc` cancels). The highlight moves while the modifier is held, so you can skip past sessions before committing on release. It is built for DSH Desktop: in a browser tab `Ctrl+Tab` belongs to the browser, so the plugin won't fire there.

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Hold `Ctrl`, tap `Tab` | Open the list and highlight the next recently viewed session; tap again to move down |
| `Ctrl` + `Shift` + `Tab` | Move the highlight backwards |
| Release the modifier(s) | Open the highlighted session and close the list |
| `Esc` | Cancel without switching |
| `Enter` / click a row | Open that session immediately |
| `↑` / `↓` | Move the highlight while the list is open |
| Click outside / window blur | Cancel |

## 安装 / Installation

### 从插件管理器安装（推荐）/ Install from the plugin manager

The plugin is a normal DSH bundle, so DSH's own plugin manager can install and enable it:

1. Open the **Plugins** page in DSH (the plugin manager page in the sidebar; 中文界面为「插件」).
2. Select **Add plugin** → **Install a third-party plugin**（「添加插件」→「安装第三方插件」）.
3. Enter the repository address and select **Install**:

   ```text
   https://github.com/Yporcupine/dsh-session-switcher
   ```

4. If DSH asks for a restart, restart DSH Desktop. The installer adds the dependency to your profile and enables the bundle for you; no manual configuration is needed.

To disable or uninstall the plugin later, use the same **Plugins** page.

### 命令行安装 / Install with the CLI

The same installation is available from the `dsh` CLI:

```bash
dsh plugin add https://github.com/Yporcupine/dsh-session-switcher
```

Use `--profile <name>` to target a specific profile (for example `dsh plugin --profile desktop add ...`). The CLI may ask you to restart DSH afterwards. You can also install the release tarball — paste the download link of the `dsh-session-switcher-1.3.0.tgz` asset from the [Releases page](https://github.com/Yporcupine/dsh-session-switcher/releases) into the same dialog or command.

### 本地开发安装 / Local checkout (development)

To hack on the plugin, run a checkout as a linked bundle. Prefer DSH's own installer — it writes the `link:` dependency **and** runs the profile's package install, so the checkout is linked into the profile; editing the manifest by hand alone skips that step and the bundle is skipped at startup.

1. Clone the repository into your DSH bundles directory (`~/.dsh/bundles/`; Windows: `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\bundles\`):

   ```bash
   # macOS / Linux
   git clone https://github.com/Yporcupine/dsh-session-switcher.git ~/.dsh/bundles/session-switcher
   ```

   ```powershell
   # Windows (PowerShell)
   git clone https://github.com/Yporcupine/dsh-session-switcher.git "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\bundles\session-switcher"
   ```

2. Install the checkout through the same add-plugin flow, pointing it at the local directory: **Plugins** page → **Add plugin** → **Install a third-party plugin** → enter the absolute path of the checkout (`/home/<you>/.dsh/bundles/session-switcher`, `/Users/<you>/.dsh/bundles/session-switcher`, or `C:/Users/<you>/.dsh/bundles/session-switcher`). Or use the CLI:

   ```bash
   dsh plugin --profile desktop add /home/<you>/.dsh/bundles/session-switcher
   ```

   DSH records a `link:` dependency, installs it into the profile, and enables the bundle.

3. Restart DSH Desktop. After later edits to the checkout, restart DSH Desktop (or disable and re-enable the bundle on the **Plugins** page) to remount the client module.

#### 手动回退 / Fallback: edit the profile manifest by hand

Only if the installer cannot be used. Edit the DSH Desktop profile manifest, `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json` (Windows: `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\package.json`), to add the dependency and the bundle selection:

```json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-session-switcher": "link:/home/<you>/.dsh/bundles/session-switcher"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": ["...", "dsh-session-switcher"]
    }
  }
}
```

Use the absolute path of your clone: `/home/<you>/...` on Linux, `/Users/<you>/...` on macOS, `C:/Users/<you>/...` on Windows (JSON paths use forward slashes on every OS); from the profile directory the relative form `link:../../bundles/session-switcher` resolves to the same location. Then relink and reinstall the profile — without this the linked package never reaches `node_modules` and the bundle is skipped:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop install
```

Restart DSH Desktop afterwards.

> **浏览器 / Browser:** the shortcuts target DSH Desktop. In a browser tab `Ctrl+Tab` belongs to the browser, so the plugin won't fire there.

## 中文说明

DSH Desktop 插件：按住 `Ctrl` 敲 `Tab`，弹出「最近会话」浮动小窗，高亮待切换的会话；
**松开修饰键即打开高亮会话**并收起小窗。

| 操作 | 效果 |
| --- | --- |
| `Ctrl+Tab`（按住 Ctrl 连按 Tab） | 打开浮动窗，高亮「下一个最近查看的会话」；继续按 Tab 依次下移 |
| `Ctrl+Shift+Tab` | 反向移动高亮 |
| 松开修饰键 | 打开高亮会话，关闭小窗 |
| `Esc` | 取消，不切换 |
| `Enter` / 鼠标点击某一行 | 立即打开该会话 |
| `↑` / `↓` | 移动高亮（小窗打开时） |
| 点击小窗外 / 窗口失焦 | 取消 |

- 插件按 DSH Desktop 设计：浏览器里 `Ctrl+Tab` 归浏览器所有，插件不会被触发。
- macOS 同样使用 `Ctrl+Tab` / `Ctrl+Shift+Tab`（`Cmd+Tab` 是系统应用切换，应用收不到）。

### 实现要点：为什么用 fixed 输入而不是可编辑快捷键

DSH Desktop 的**原生键盘桥**会先于页面拦截「可编辑快捷键」的按键组合，然后 Electron
会吞掉随后的**修饰键 keyup**（DSH 官方 shortcuts 文档的 “Understand the implementation” 一节
也说明：Electron 在原生拦截之后可能省略 keyup）。一旦 `Ctrl` 的 keyup 到不了页面，浮动窗就无法知道「Ctrl 已松开」，
只能等下一次按键——这正是早期版本「松开 Ctrl 无反应、要再按一次 Ctrl 才切换」的根因
（已用合成按键 + UI Automation 实测复现：`Ctrl+Tab`、`Ctrl+B` 等任何可编辑快捷键之后
都收不到 `keyup`）。

因此 `Ctrl+Tab` / `Ctrl+Shift+Tab` 注册为 **fixed 输入动作**（`ctx.shortcuts.registerFixed`
+ `ctx.shortcuts.observeFixedInput`）：fixed 动作不走原生桥拦截，留在正常的 DOM 输入路径，
修饰键 keyup 可以正常收到，于是「松手提交」可靠。代价是这两行在
**Settings → Keyboard shortcuts**（`Mod+/`）里显示为只读条目（Application 分组，键帽
`Ctrl + Tab` / `Ctrl + Shift + Tab`），不能改键；不想要时停用/卸载插件即可。

#### 为什么点击行曾「只关窗、不切换」（已修复）

DSH 的 shortcuts 服务在**每个 `pointerdown`** 上都会给 fixed 输入观察者发一次
`{ type: "reset" }`（用于中断多键序列）。早期版本把 reset 一律当作取消：鼠标按下瞬间
小窗就被卸载，行的 React `click` 永远来不及触发——于是「点一下小窗消失，但会话没切换」。
现在的做法是：在 **window 捕获阶段**（早于 shortcuts 服务的 document 捕获 reset）先判断
这次按下是否落在小窗内；**落在窗内的按下不算取消**，只吞掉紧接着的 reset，让行正常收到
click 并切换；点到窗外仍然立即取消。松开指针（`pointerup`/`pointercancel`）后恢复常规
reset 行为。

### 参考实现

当前 ChatGPT / Codex 桌面端（2026，版本 26）把 `Ctrl+Tab` 定义为 **“Next recently viewed chat”**，
`Ctrl+Shift+Tab` 为 **“Previous recently viewed chat”**（另有 `Ctrl+PageDown/PageUp`、
`Ctrl+Shift+]`/`[` 等别名）；Codex 应用更新日志也提到加入了「跳转到最近线程的键盘快捷键」。
本插件按这个语义实现：

`--dsw-alias-label-tertiary`；`prefers-reduced-motion` 下两段动画停止、弧固定。运行状态
来自 frame 槽作用域提供的 `useSessionStatus` 钩子（实时订阅），取不到时回退到会话列表
快照里的 `running` 提示；它会和「当前」标记并排显示，但始终位于最右侧。

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-ottosmother

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that gives the model a private glossary. The user
writes 「滚木」 meaning 「没有」 and 「棍母」 meaning 「不存在」; the model is told to
read those words as their meaning and, when it needs to express that meaning,
to phrase the whole sentence naturally with a glossary word instead of
mechanically swapping a single token.

The plugin only adds one **system prompt section**. It does not rewrite user
input, does not wrap model output, and does not register any message hooks.
A graphical settings page lets you manage the glossary files, the master
switch and the reminder strength without editing YAML by hand.

## Layout

```
glossaries/         # bundled category word lists (moba, fps, comments, ai, dev, private)
lib/config.js       # schema, YAML loading, prompt text builder, settings snapshot
lib/prompt.js       # system prompt section registration
lib/routes.js       # two local HTTP routes for the settings page
lib/index.js        # plugin entry
client.js           # settings page (Settings → dsh-ottosmother)
```

## Word lists

Word lists live in YAML files, not in the code. The package ships one file per
category (`glossaries/*.yaml`); your own files go to `~/.dsh/ottosmother/`
(created on demand by the settings page). Every file has the same shape:

```yaml
title: 我的词表            # group heading in the prompt
description: 说明           # shown in the settings page
terms:
  - word: 滚木
    meaning: 没有
  - word: 棍母
    meaning: 不存在
```

A file whose root is a plain list of `{ word, meaning }` items is accepted too.
File contents are re-read when the file's mtime/size changes, so edits take
effect on the next turn. The prompt itself contains only the glossary and
generic rules (read the word as its meaning, use the words when expressing that
meaning, keep code / commands / paths / URLs / error text verbatim). No example
sentences are hard-coded — how a particular word should be understood is left to
the model.

## Settings page

`Settings → dsh-ottosmother` (a `settings.section` slot):

- master switch and reminder strength (`quiet` / `normal` / `strong`);
- one switch per loaded glossary file (disabled files stay listed but are not
  injected);
- the resolved user directory and the bundled directory, each with an
  "open folder" button;
- a refresh button plus error/warning list for unreadable or broken YAML files.

Settings are written through `configForms`, so changes apply immediately
without reloading the plugin. The page talks to two exact host routes:

| Route | Method | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/dsh-ottosmother/catalog` | GET | JSON snapshot: files, counts, switches, directories, warnings |
| `/dsh-ottosmother/reveal` | POST | Create and open a glossary folder in the OS file manager |

Both routes are same-origin checked: loopback host only, cross-site requests
get 403, and no file content is ever written through them.

## How it works

| Extension point | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `systemPrompt.section` | Injects the 「私密词表」 section: glossary lines + generic reading/writing rules |
| `settings.section` (client) | Renders the settings page |
| `webServer` (exact routes) | Serves the catalog snapshot and the reveal action |

Section name `dsh-ottosmother/glossary`, order 50. The text is produced by a
function and re-read from config on every prompt assembly; when the plugin is
disabled or the word list is empty, the section text is an empty string and
nothing is injected. A broken YAML file is logged once instead of crashing the
session.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-ottosmother
```

Or from the release tarball / GitHub:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add https://github.com/hj9178/dsh-ottosmother/releases/download/v0.6.0/dsh-ottosmother-0.6.0.tgz
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:hj9178/dsh-ottosmother
```

Restart the harness after installing.

## Config

The settings page writes these fields, and you can also set them in the
profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-ottosmother
      name: 'dsh-ottosmother'
      inject: [systemPrompt]
      config:
        enabled: true
        reminder: normal
        disabledGlossaries: []
        glossaryDirs: []
        userDir: ''
        terms: []
```

- `enabled`: master switch; when false nothing is injected.
- `reminder`: `quiet` gives the list plus one line; `normal` explains reading
  and writing; `strong` explicitly asks the model to actively use the words.
- `disabledGlossaries`: file ids to switch off (`builtin:moba.yaml`,
  `user:mine.yaml`).
- `glossaryDirs`: extra directories to scan for `.yaml`/`.yml` word lists.
- `userDir`: personal glossary directory (empty = `~/.dsh/ottosmother`).
- `terms`: inline word list, merged after the files (duplicates dropped).

All settings-page fields are declared `.volatile()`, so edits apply immediately
on hosts that support it (schemastery ≥ 3.18.3).

## Known behaviour

- Whether the model writes 「滚木 / 棍母」 is its own decision; it may still say
  「没有」, and it may rewrite when explicitly asked.
- Code is not protected by code — the rule only asks the model to keep it
  verbatim.
- Other LLM calls in the harness (title generation, etc.) receive the same
  system prompt section.
- The settings page needs the harness Web host; headless profiles still get the
  prompt section, just no page.

## License

MIT.

# dsh-ottosmother（中文）

给 DeepSeek Harness 的插件，把一份私人词表写进 system prompt：用户写
「滚木」要理解成「没有」，写「棍母」要理解成「不存在」；模型要表达「没有 /
不存在」时，用这些词把整句组织得自然通顺，而不是机械扣掉两个字再塞一个词。

插件只加一个 **system prompt 段落**：不改用户输入、不包装模型输出、不注册任何
消息钩子。设置界面里可以直接管理词表文件、总开关和提醒强度，不用手改 YAML。

## 结构

```
glossaries/         # 包内分类词表（moba、fps、comments、ai、dev、private）
lib/config.js       # schema、YAML 解析、提示词生成、设置页快照
lib/prompt.js       # system prompt 段落注册
lib/routes.js       # 设置页用的两条本地路由
lib/index.js        # 插件入口
client.js           # 设置页（设置 → dsh-ottosmother）
```

## 词表

词表放在 YAML 文件里，不写死在代码里。包内每个分类一个文件
（`glossaries/*.yaml`），自己的文件放 `~/.dsh/ottosmother/`（设置页首次打开
文件夹时自动创建）。所有文件格式一致：

```yaml
title: 我的词表            # 提示词里的分组标题
description: 说明           # 设置页里显示的说明
terms:
  - word: 滚木
    meaning: 没有
  - word: 棍母
    meaning: 不存在
```

根节点直接是 `{ word, meaning }` 数组的写法也接受。文件 mtime/size 变化时下次
组装自动重读，改完下一轮对话即生效。提示词本身只有词表和通用规则（按含义理解、
需要时用这些词表达、代码 / 命令 / 路径 / URL / 报错原文保持原样），不写死任何
例句——某个词具体该怎么理解，交给模型自己判断。

## 设置页

`设置 → dsh-ottosmother`（`settings.section` 槽位）：

- 总开关和提醒强度（`quiet` / `normal` / `strong`）；
- 每个已加载词表文件一个开关（关掉的文件仍列在清单里，只是不注入）；
- 个人词表目录和包内目录，各带一个「打开文件夹」按钮；
- 刷新按钮，以及读取失败 / YAML 损坏的提示列表。

设置通过 `configForms` 写入，改完即时生效，不用重载插件。页面只调用两条
exact 路由：

| 路由 | 方法 | 用途 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/dsh-ottosmother/catalog` | GET | JSON 快照：文件清单、词条数、开关、目录、警告 |
| `/dsh-ottosmother/reveal` | POST | 创建并在系统文件管理器打开词表目录 |

两条路由都做同源校验：只接受 loopback host，跨站请求返回 403，且不通过路由写
任何词表内容。

## 生效方式

| 扩展点 | 做什么 |
| --- | --- |
| `systemPrompt.section` | 注入「私密词表」段落：词表 + 通用理解/表达规则 |
| `settings.section`（客户端） | 渲染设置页 |
| `webServer`（exact 路由） | 提供词表快照与打开文件夹 |

段落名 `dsh-ottosmother/glossary`，order 50。文本由函数提供，每次组装 prompt
时现读配置；插件关闭或词表为空时返回空串，等价于不注入。YAML 损坏只记一次
日志，不会让会话崩溃。

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-ottosmother
```

或从 GitHub / Release 安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add https://github.com/hj9178/dsh-ottosmother/releases/download/v0.6.0/dsh-ottosmother-0.6.0.tgz
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:hj9178/dsh-ottosmother
```

安装后重启 harness 生效。

## 配置

设置页写入的就是这些字段，也可以写在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-ottosmother
      name: 'dsh-ottosmother'
      inject: [systemPrompt]
      config:
        enabled: true
        reminder: normal
        disabledGlossaries: []
        glossaryDirs: []
        userDir: ''
        terms: []
```

- `enabled`：总开关，关掉后不注入任何内容。
- `reminder`：提醒强度。`quiet` 只给词表加一行；`normal` 说明理解与表达；
  `strong` 明确要求模型主动使用这些词。
- `disabledGlossaries`：关掉的词表文件 id（`builtin:moba.yaml`、`user:mine.yaml`）。
- `glossaryDirs`：额外扫描的 `.yaml`/`.yml` 词表目录。
- `userDir`：个人词表目录（留空用 `~/.dsh/ottosmother`）。
- `terms`：内联词条，在文件之后合并（重复项自动去掉）。

设置页字段都声明了 `.volatile()`，在支持的宿主（schemastery ≥ 3.18.3）上改完
即时生效。

## 已知行为

- 模型是否用「滚木 / 棍母」表达由模型自己判断，可能偶尔说成「没有」。
- 代码没有被代码保护——规则只是要求模型
