plugins.description: 复杂项目模式 preset for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): the standard tool stack plus a four-document policy, current-state-only docs, a no-unrequested-push rule, careful coding, and plain-language reporting.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-complex-project-preset

**An agent preset for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): the full standard tool stack, plus the discipline to think before it types.**

> 中文版: [README.zh.md](README.zh.md)

The whole preset lives in [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml): it inserts one `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset` row into the profile and registers a preset with the id `complex-project`. The package ships **configuration only** — no host code, no browser UI — so there is very little that an upgrade can break.

---

## Why

The standard preset gets work done, but it will not hold a line on its own: diffs creep, project docs turn into changelogs, and code goes up before you said so.

This preset writes four rules into the persona prompt, so every session starts with them already in force:

| Rule | In one line |
| --- | --- |
| Four documents | A project keeps at most four docs: intro, decisions, change log, current state & next steps |
| Current state only | No AI edit history, no superseded decisions, no leftover "stage 1–5" wording |
| Commit/push red line | No `git commit`, `git push`, or PR until you explicitly say so |
| Careful coding + plain language | Restate the goal and the done-criteria first, make surgical diffs, lead reports with the conclusion |

## What's inside

The tool stack matches the standard preset — bash/pwsh chosen per platform, file read/write and search, tasks and background jobs, skills, plan mode, compaction, subagents and workflows, web fetch, the TODO tool, present. What differs is the persona prompt and the documentation rules:

- `persona` — the four-document policy, current-state-only docs, the commit/push red line, the careful-coding rules, and plain-language reporting;
- `agent-instructions` — still loads your global `AGENTS.md` (64 KB cap);
- `planning` / `compaction` / `delegation` — same groups and isolation settings as standard;
- `tool-plugin-manager` — disabled, so the agent cannot rewrite its own plugin tree.

> ⚠️ The persona block deliberately sets **no `suffix`**. DSH registers only `provider` and `model` as prompt variables; any other `{{name}}` throws during prompt assembly and the whole turn fails before a single request is sent. The working directory is injected by the runtime context already, so declaring it here is redundant as well as fatal.

## Install

```sh
# from npm (recommended — prebuilt install, no build approval)
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-complex-project-preset

# or from the repository / a local directory
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/sueqet/dsh-complex-project-preset
dsh plugin --profile web add link:<local-dir>
```

**Restart the profile** (run `dsh web` again, or restart the desktop app) — a preset is a row in the profile composition, not a runtime hot-load.

Uninstall: `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-complex-project-preset`

### Conflicts with a hand-rolled copy

If your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` already declares `- id: preset-complex-project` by hand, installing this package registers the same preset twice and DSH reports `Duplicate agent preset: complex-project`. To switch over:

1. delete that `- id: preset-complex-project ...` block from your `cordis.patch.yml`;
2. `dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-complex-project-preset`;
3. restart the profile.

Only one package should provide `complex-project` at a time.

### Version requirement

Requires **DSH ≥ 0.1.7-rc.2** (the preset registry `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset-registry` joins the base composition there) and **Node.js ≥ 22.19.0**. Verified on DSH 0.1.7-rc.2 and on the desktop build 0.2.1-rc.2.

The Node floor is the harness's own rather than this package's: DSH compositions call `process.getBuiltinModule`, which Node ships from 22.3 onwards. This package is a manifest plus one YAML patch — no host code, no browser code, no install-time scripts — so it never loads JavaScript of its own, and the floor only mirrors where DSH can run at all.

## Verify

After a restart, open the mode picker for a new session: **复杂项目模式** (order 2, right after the standard preset) should be listed. Start a session with it and ask about the project's current state — the answer should talk in terms of the four documents rather than freeform.

From the CLI you can also inspect the composed tree:

```sh
dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -A3 preset-complex-project
```

## Develop

```sh
npm test          # checks manifest + cordis.patch.yml consistency, including !!js parsing
npm pack --dry-run
```

`tools/smoke.mjs` verifies that `dsh.bundle.patch` points at a file that exists, that `repository` points back at this repo, that every required preset field is present, that child row ids are unique, and that the persona prompt is neither truncated nor carrying a stray `suffix`. It parses the patch with the harness's own `loadOverlayPatches` when available, so `!!js` expressions behave exactly as they do at boot.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 sueqet

plugins.description: bioRxiv preprint search, version/status and export tools for DeepSeek Harness (dsh). Zero runtime dependencies.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-biorxiv

bioRxiv preprint search, version/publication status and export tools for DeepSeek Harness (dsh). Zero runtime dependencies.

> Status: `0.1.0-alpha` — functional core, not a 1.0 release. Relevance evaluation is provisional; do not treat it as peer-reviewed evidence.

## Tools

- `biorxiv_search` — search bioRxiv preprints by topic, optional date window and field. Default `minScore=3` filters low-confidence text matches; set `minScore=0` for higher recall.
- `biorxiv_paper` — DOI lookup: latest version, publication DOI/journal, retraction flag when available.
- `biorxiv_latest` — latest preprints by date window and optional category.
- `biorxiv_export` — export search results or one DOI as JSON, Markdown, CSV or BibTeX.
- `biorxiv_digest` — structured markdown digest (extractive by default; optional opt-in Chinese summaries; no automatic delivery).

All tools return a stable envelope:

```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "data": {},
  "error": { "code": "", "message": "", "retryable": false, "hint": "" },
  "meta": { "requestId": "...", "elapsedMs": 12, "cached": false, "source": ["europepmc"], "warnings": [] }
}
```

On failure `ok` is `false`, `data` is `{}`, and `error.code` is one of `E-001`–`E-010`.

## Install (one command)

```bash
dsh plugin --profile headless add github:TYEclipse/dsh-biorxiv#v0.1.0-alpha.20
```

Replace `headless` with the target profile. `dsh plugin add` is a pnpm forwarder: a `--profile` is required, and `pnpm` must be on `PATH`.

Build from source instead:

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm build
pnpm pack
dsh plugin --profile headless add "file:$PWD/$(ls -t dsh-biorxiv-*.tgz | head -1)"
```

Verify:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile headless list
dsh --profile headless "Use biorxiv_search to search for 'protein language model' and report the first title and DOI."
```

`dsh plugin add` is a pnpm forwarder: a `--profile` is required, and `pnpm` must be on `PATH`.

## CLI

```bash
dsh-biorxiv search "protein language model" --limit 5
dsh-biorxiv paper 10.64898/2026.07.21.739963
dsh-biorxiv latest --days 2 --limit 10
dsh-biorxiv export "hippocampal ripple" --format markdown --out refs.md
dsh-biorxiv digest "protein language model" --limit 5
```

Each command prints one JSON envelope and exits `0` on success, `1` on a tool error, `2` on a usage error.

## MCP

Run the stdio server:

```bash
dsh-biorxiv-mcp
```

MCP client config example:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "biorxiv": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "--package", "dsh-biorxiv", "dsh-biorxiv-mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```

An npm package is not published yet. The `npx` form above works after publication; for a GitHub install, point the client at `node ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/dsh-biorxiv/dist/apps/mcp/main.js`.

The server exposes `biorxiv_search`, `biorxiv_paper`, `biorxiv_latest`, `biorxiv_export` and `biorxiv_digest` with the same JSON envelope.

## Configuration

Defaults live in the plugin schema; no config is required.

```json
{
  "cachePath": "~/.cache/dsh-biorxiv/cache.db",
  "cacheMode": "auto",
  "timeoutMs": 10000,
  "retries": 2,
  "maxBytes": 2000000,
  "userAgent": "dsh-biorxiv/0.1 (DeepSeek Harness plugin)",
  "summaryEnabled": false,
  "summaryModel": "deepseek-chat",
  "summaryBaseUrl": "https://api.deepseek.com",
  "summaryApiKeyEnv": "DEEPSEEK_API_KEY"
}
```

- `summaryEnabled`: default `false`. When true, `digest --summary` sends only public title/abstract to the configured model and labels output as machine-generated.
- The API key is read from the named environment variable; it is never written to config, cache or logs.
- CLI: `dsh-biorxiv digest "topic" --summary` opts in; it also enables the provider for that process.
- MCP: set `DSH_BIORXIV_SUMMARY=1` in the server environment, then call `biorxiv_digest` with `summary: true`.

- `cacheMode`: `auto` (SQLite when available, JSON fallback), `sqlite`, or `json`.
- Cache keys are SHA-256 hashes; query text is not written into the cache key.
- Delete the cache file to reset; it is disposable.

## Data sources and boundaries

- Search: Europe PMC REST (`SRC:PPR` + `PUBLISHER:"bioRxiv"`).
- Latest/version details: bioRxiv public API.
- Journal/retraction enrichment: Crossref and OpenAlex; failures are non-blocking.
- No full-text PDF download, no scraping behind 403/paywalls, no writes to source sites.
- Do not use for clinical, medical or investment decisions. Preprints are not peer-reviewed.

## Development

```bash
pnpm test
pnpm coverage
```

The coverage ratchet is enforced by `scripts/coverage-ratchet.mjs`; line coverage must not fall below `.coverage-baseline.json`.

## License

MIT. See `LICENSE`. Privacy and data flow: see `PRIVACY.md`.

plugins.description: Deterministic financial-data and valuation plugin for DeepSeek Harness: six ratio groups, forecast ratios, DCF slots, comparable PS/PE, IRR — one unified schema.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-valuation-service

A deterministic financial-data and valuation plugin for **DeepSeek Harness**. It reads a workpaper layout of `01.json` / `02.json` / `04.json`, computes six ratio groups, forecast ratios, DCF input slots, comparable PS / PE and IRR, and writes one unified schema per project set.

It registers one agent tool, **`valuation_service`**. No AI inference, no invented numbers: anything missing is left blank and marked `missing` for a human or a downstream research step to fill.

## What it computes

| Block | Content |
|---|---|
| `ratios.historical` | profitability, solvency, efficiency, cash flow, valuation, growth |
| `ratios.forecast` | forecast-period profitability / growth / expense; BS- and CF-dependent ratios marked missing |
| `dcf` | full input slots (WACC, g, tax, EBIT, D&A, capex, ΔWC, net debt), outputs, missing list, hand-off anchors |
| `comparable` | PS and PE in parallel: trimmed mean, all-sample mean, 1-year mean, pre-money multiple, premium |
| `irr` | target / conservative / optimistic, closed-vs-open judgement, deviation |
| `assumption_diff` | material assumptions vs assumptions computed from actuals, field by field |
| `pending` / `gate` | unresolved conflicts and C2–C7 gate status when the workpapers carry them |

## Input layout

```text
<base>/
├── 项目A/
│   └── json/
│       ├── 01.json   # financial.raw (BS/IS/CF) + financial.ratios
│       ├── 02.json   # assumptions.forecast + assumptions.comparables + assumptions.valuation
│       └── 04.json   # validation.irr_recompute
└── 项目B/
    └── json/...
```

`--base` defaults to `$DSH_VALUATION_BASE` or `./数据底表`. Projects are discovered dynamically: every directory with all three JSON files is included. No project list is hard-coded.

`01.json` may use either `raw = {bs, is, cf}` or report-title sections (e.g. `"一、资产负债表 · 资产"`); both are normalized.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin add https://github.com/zirscard/dsh-valuation-service
```

Or from a local directory:

```bash
dsh plugin add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-valuation-service
```

Restart DSH; a new session gets the `valuation_service` tool.

## Tool usage

```json
{
  "base": "/path/to/数据底表",
  "projects": "项目A,项目B",
  "write": true
}
```

- `base` (string, optional): workpaper root; relative paths resolve against the session working directory.
- `projects` (string or array, optional): restrict to these project directory names.
- `write` (boolean, optional, default `false`): write `<base>/valuations-service.json`.
- `out` (string, optional): override the output path.

The tool returns a per-project summary (DCF status and missing list, PS/PE status, IRR closed flag, assumption-diff count, gate) plus the output path.

## CLI usage

The Python entry point is usable without DSH (standard library only):

```bash
python3 core/valuation_service.py --base /path/to/数据底表 --dry-run
python3 core/valuation_service.py --base /path/to/数据底表 --projects 项目A
python3 core/valuation_service.py --base /path/to/数据底表 --write
python3 core/valuation_service.py --base /path/to/数据底表 --write --json
```

`--json` prints one machine-readable summary object; `--write` writes the aggregate file; without `--write` it is a dry run.

## Unified schema

```json
{
  "schema": "m1.valuation-service/v2",
  "project_id": "...",
  "project_name": "...",
  "currency": "CNY",
  "method": "...",
  "financial_inputs": {"period": "...", "is": {}, "bs": {}, "cf": {}},
  "ratios": {"historical": {}, "forecast": {}},
  "dcf": {"status": "computed|partial|unavailable", "inputs": {}, "outputs": {}, "missing": [], "m3_handoff": {}},
  "comparable": {"ps": {}, "pe": {}},
  "irr": {"target": null, "conservative": null, "optimistic": null, "closed": false, "judge": "", "dev": null},
  "assumption_diff": [],
  "pending": [],
  "gate": {}
}
```

The aggregate file wraps records as `{"schema": "m1.valuation-service/aggregate/v2", "generated_at": "...", "base": "...", "projects": [...], "errors": [...]}`.

## Formulas

- Ratios: gross / operating / net margin, ROE, ROA; current / quick / cash ratio, debt-to-equity, debt-to-assets, interest coverage; asset / inventory / receivables turnover and days; OCF ratios; PS / PE / EV / EV-EBITDA; revenue and net-income growth.
- DCF: `FCFF = EBIT × (1 − t) + D&A − capex − ΔWC`; `TV = FCFF_last × (1 + g) / (WACC − g)`; `EV = Σ PV(FCFF) + PV(TV)`; `equity = EV − net debt`.
- Comparable: trimmed mean (10% each side when n ≥ 5), all-sample mean, 1-year mean, pre-money multiple, premium.
- IRR: `(exit value / invested capital) ^ (1 / years) − 1`.
- Assumption diff: material assumption vs module-computed actual, per field.

Ratio formulas are adapted from [anthropics/claude-cookbooks · analyzing-financial-statements/calculate_ratios.py](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-cookbooks/blob/main/skills/custom_skills/analyzing-financial-statements/calculate_ratios.py) (MIT), mapped onto Chinese three-statement labels.

## Adaptation layer

Data variants are handled in one place instead of per project:

| Variant | Function | Rule |
|---|---|---|
| raw layout (`{bs,is,cf}` vs report-title sections) | `_normalize_raw` | normalize by 资产负债表 / 利润表 / 现金流量表 keywords |
| units (thousand / ten-thousand / million CNY) | `_unit_for` | field-name suffix first, then `forecast.unit` |
| field-name variants | `_find_param` | keyword match + exclusion words |
| total vs line item (`资产总计` vs `流动资产合计`) | `_find_val` | totals require an exact match, no substring fallback |
| self-comparison in the comp set | `_included` | drop rows whose `treatment` says 自比 / 剔除 |
| no market PE multiple | `comparable.pe.status=assumption` | use the assumption range explicitly, never present it as a market multiple |

If a new variant is structural (layout / unit / naming), add it to the adapter. If it is a measurement convention, add it to the skill formulas. If data is missing, leave it blank and mark `missing`.

## DCF hand-off

Missing DCF inputs stay blank; `dcf.m3_handoff.anchors` lists what each one needs:

| Missing input | Anchor to fill |
|---|---|
| WACC | risk-free rate / beta / equity risk premium / capital structure |
| g | long-run GDP growth / industry terminal growth |
| capex | capex plan / construction in progress / capacity expansion |
| D&A | depreciation and amortization policy |
| ΔWC | receivables / inventory / payables turnover forecast |
| tax rate | effective tax rate |
| net debt | interest-bearing debt − cash |

## Test

```bash
python3 test/run_tests.py
```

The test builds a synthetic three-project workpaper set in a temporary directory (no client data), runs the service, and checks ratio values, DCF missing slots, comparable status, IRR and the written aggregate file.

## Boundaries

- No AI inference, no model calls, no network requests.
- No client data or project names are shipped in this repository.
- Missing inputs are marked, not fabricated.
- It does not replace a valuation model: it standardizes inputs and keeps the slots.

## License

MIT. Ratio formulas adapted from anthropics/claude-cookbooks (MIT); see [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](./THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).

plugins.description: Adds a /sum slash command that summarizes the last N chat messages into a structured digest.
bilibili-note 的 DSH 插件封装版（衍生自 3588834014-del/bilibili-note）：把 B站视频链接变成 Obsidian 结构化笔记，只拉字幕不下载视频。
plugins.readme_text:
# bilibili-note

> **DSH plugin packaging of [`3588834014-del/bilibili-note`](https://github.com/3588834014-del/bilibili-note).**
>
> This repository is the **plugin edition**: the upstream project plus a DeepSeek Harness
> bundle wrapper (`package.json` / `cordis.patch.yml` / `lib/index.js`). The original
> skill + CLI lives upstream — use that one if you don't need to install it as a dsh plugin.
> GitHub does not allow forking a repository into the same account, so this is a derivative
> copy rather than a fork-network fork.

> **Turn Bilibili videos into structured Obsidian notes — subtitles only, never the video.**
>
> 中文说明见 [README.zh-CN.md](README.zh-CN.md)。

[![CI](https://github.com/3588834014-del/bilibili-note/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/3588834014-del/bilibili-note/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Python 3.8+](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.8%2B-blue.svg)](https://www.python.org/)

A small CLI — plus an optional agent skill — that turns a Bilibili video into a structured
Markdown note in your Obsidian vault. It downloads **only the subtitle file** (`--skip-download`),
cleans the timestamps, and writes a note with YAML front matter, a summary section, bullet
points carrying clickable `?t=` jump links, and the full transcript collapsed at the bottom.

The repetitive half (fetch, parse, format, verify) is a script. The judgment half (summary,
key points, tags) is left as a documented contract you or an agent fill in.

```
Bilibili URL ──▶ fetch ──▶ manifest.json ──▶ [you / agent] ──▶ content.json ──▶ write ──▶ note.md
                  │         subtitles +                      summary, bullets,       │
                  │         timestamped segments             tags                    │
                  └── yt-dlp, subtitles only ────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## Real output

`fetch` on a real video — note what is *not* there: no `.mp4`, `.flv`, `.m4a` or `.part`,
only the subtitle file and its manifest.

![fetch: subtitles only, no media files](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/3588834014-del/bilibili-note/main/docs/images/demo-fetch.png)

And the note it produces (Obsidian rendering — front matter, clickable `?t=` jump links,
summary, bullets, tags). Screenshot taken from a real run, not a mock-up:

![the generated note](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/3588834014-del/bilibili-note/main/docs/images/demo-note.png)

## Why this one

- **Subtitles only.** `--skip-download` is mandatory, and the tool verifies no media file
  (`.mp4/.flv/.m4a/.part`) landed in the working directory. No reverse-engineering, no
  private APIs — just `yt-dlp`.
- **Multi-part videos are merged.** For an anthology (B站 分P 合集) it fetches every part's
  subtitles and rebases the timestamps onto one continuous timeline. Verified on a real
  6-part anthology: **2:10:32 → 2807 segments / 33214 characters**, matching an independent
  concatenation segment-for-segment. A part with no subtitles is skipped **while keeping its
  time slot**, so later timestamps stay correct.
- **It refuses to produce garbage.** If two parts yield byte-identical subtitles, it errors out
  instead of silently emitting a note whose content is one part repeated N times. (That exact
  bug shipped during development and was caught by this guard.)
- **No subtitles? It skips and tells you.** It never fabricates content or writes an empty note.

## Install

No dependencies — standard library only. `yt-dlp` is an **external command**, not a Python package.

### As a DSH plugin (recommended for DeepSeek Harness)

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:3588834014-del/bilibili-note-plugin
```

This is a **bundle plugin** that registers the `bilibili-note` skill straight into the DSH skill
catalog — no manual copying into `~/.agents/skills`. Restart your profile afterwards and the
skill is available; the model picks it up from phrases like 「B站笔记」 or a pasted BV link.

The plugin ships its own copy of `scripts/bili_note.py`, `docs/` and `SKILL.md`, and rewrites
the `<skill-dir>` placeholders in the skill body to the **absolute install path**, so the model
never has to guess where the script lives. Uninstall with
`dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-bilibili-note`.

> There is no npm package yet, so this plugin is **source-installed** — it is listed on
> [dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org) but will not appear in the in-app plugin store.
> pnpm ≥10 may ask you to allow the git dependency's build script; this package has no
> `prepare` script, so nothing runs at install time.

### As a standalone CLI

```bash
pipx install git+https://github.com/3588834014-del/bilibili-note.git
# or
git clone https://github.com/3588834014-del/bilibili-note.git
cd bilibili-note && python -m pip install .
```

Then:

```bash
bili-note --version
bili-note note "https://www.bilibili.com/video/BVxxxxxxxxx" \
    --note-dir ~/MyVault/Sources/Videos
```

### As a plain agent skill (no plugin)

```bash
python scripts/install.py            # installs to ~/.agents/skills/bilibili-note
python scripts/install.py --dry-run  # show what would be copied
```

The skill then appears in the dsh skill catalog and can be triggered with phrases like
「B站笔记」. The plugin, the skill-file install and the CLI all share the same implementation
(`scripts/bili_note.py`).

### Requirements

| Requirement | Notes |
|---|---|
| Python 3.8+ | stdlib only |
| [`yt-dlp`](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp) | `pip install -U yt-dlp` — the **only** download channel |
| Bilibili login cookies | Required for AI subtitles; see below |
| DSH `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0` | Only for the plugin/skill route |

### Permissions and external services

Worth knowing before you install, since this tool touches the network and your vault:

- **Network**: talks to `bilibili.com` through `yt-dlp` only. It downloads **subtitles**, never
  video or audio (`--skip-download` is mandatory and verified).
- **Credentials**: reads a Bilibili cookie file from `$BILI_COOKIES` or `./cookies.txt`. It
  writes a **normalized temporary copy** next to the work dir for yt-dlp; it never uploads,
  logs, or commits cookies.
- **Filesystem**: writes notes into the `--note-dir` you pass, plus a scratch work directory.
  Nothing outside those two paths is modified.
- **No telemetry, no extra dependencies**, no reverse-engineered APIs.

## Cookies (required)

Bilibili's AI-subtitle endpoint needs an authenticated session.

1. Install the **Get cookies.txt LOCALLY** browser extension.
2. Log into [bilibili.com](https://www.bilibili.com).
3. Export `cookies.txt`.
4. Put it in your working directory, or point at it:

```bash
export BILI_COOKIES=/path/to/cookies.txt      # Linux / macOS
$env:BILI_COOKIES = "C:\path\cookies.txt"     # PowerShell
```

Videos where the uploader supplied their own subtitles may work without this.

### ⚠️ Why you can't feed the export straight to yt-dlp

This is the single most surprising thing in this repository. That extension writes lines like:

```
.bilibili.com	FALSE	/	FALSE	1819635894	SESSDATA	xxxxx
```

The domain carries a leading dot, yet the host-only flag in column 2 is `FALSE`. Python's
`http.cookiejar` asserts:

```python
assert domain_specified == initial_dot
```

The mismatch raises, and yt-dlp refuses to load the **entire file**:

```
ERROR: invalid Netscape format cookies file '...': '.bilibili.com\tFALSE\t/...'
```

The practical symptom is nasty: subtitles never arrive, and the error looks like
*"this video has no subtitles."* The fix is normalization — strip the leading dot and set the
flag to `FALSE` (a host-only cookie is still sent to `api.bilibili.com` and friends, so the
session is preserved). `normalize_cookies()` does this, plus filters to the `bilibili` domain
and de-duplicates by `domain/path/name`. You never have to do it by hand.

## Output directory

Nothing is hard-coded. Pick either:

```bash
bili-note note "<URL>" --note-dir "<vault>/Sources/Videos"    # explicit

export BILI_VAULT="/path/to/MyVault"                           # or environment
export BILI_TARGET_DIR="Sources/Videos"

plugins.description: DSH plugin: shut down / restart / lock once every session and background job has gone idle.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-shutdown-idle

DSH 插件：**开启后，等所有会话都结束（没有任何 Agent 在跑）并保持空闲，自动执行关机**（也可选重启 / 休眠 / 睡眠 / 锁定 / 注销）。

## 用起来

1. 打开「设置 → 会话结束后关机」，点 **开启**。
2. 正常派活给任意会话；所有会话的回合结束后，插件先等 `空闲确认` 秒，再进入 `倒计时` 秒。
3. 倒计时结束即执行所选动作。期间任何会话重新开始运行，或点界面上的 **取消**，这次动作都会被撤销。

右上角（浮层右下角）在开启后会常驻一张小卡片，显示当前阶段与剩余秒数，并带「取消」按钮。**按住卡片标题即可拖动**：松手后位置写进浏览器 `localStorage`（键 `dsh.shutdown-idle.pill.position`），下次打开停在原处；拖动过程始终夹在视口内（留 8px 可见），窗口变小也会自动收回视野。从「取消」按钮上按下不会误触发拖动。

## 判据

- **会话进行中** = `ctx.get('agents').list()` 里存在 `status === 'running'` 的 Agent（与 dshmarket 的更新守卫同一判据）。这一条固定生效，不可关闭。
- **后台任务** = `ctx.get('jobs')` 中 `status === 'running'` 的作业（含各存活会话名下的作业），即 DSH 界面里的「后台任务」；由配置项 `considerJobs` 决定是否检测，关掉后完全不再统计。
- 拿不到 `agents` 服务时按 **不空闲** 处理：宁可不执行，也不误关机。
- 「必须观察到会话运行过」默认开启：刚开启且没有任何任务时不会执行动作。

## 参数

| 参数 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 动作 | `shutdown` | `shutdown` / `restart` / `hibernate` / `sleep` / `lock` / `logoff` / `none`（`none` = 只记录不执行） |
| 空闲确认 | 20 秒 | 全部空闲后先确认这么久，避免回合间隙被误判为结束 |
| 倒计时 | 60 秒 | 可取消的执行前倒计时 |
| 必须观察到会话运行过 | 是 | 防止刚开启就执行 |
| 后台任务也算占用（`considerJobs`） | 是 | 关掉后完全不再检测后台任务（shell 作业） |

设置页把这几项收在「什么算『还在忙』」区块里：会话在跑固定算忙，下面两个复选框是配置项。

初始值来自本包 `cordis.patch.yml` 的行 `config`；界面改动写入 `<DSH_HOME>/dsh-shutdown-idle/settings.json` 并优先生效（删除该文件即回落到 patch 初始值）。

**开关状态不持久化**：宿主重启后一律是「关闭」，避免开机即误关机。

## 接口

| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/dsh-shutdown/api/state` | 开关、阶段、倒计时、运行中会话/作业 |
| POST | `/dsh-shutdown/api/config` | `{ enabled?, action?, settleSeconds?, countdownSeconds?, requireActivity?, considerJobs? }` |
| POST | `/dsh-shutdown/api/cancel` | 取消倒计时并关闭开关 |
| GET | `/dsh-shutdown` | 客户端半不可用时的兜底页面 |

## 平台

动作命令是 Windows 自带的 `shutdown` / `rundll32`。非 Windows 平台上，除 `none` 外的动作会被降级为 `none` 并在界面标注，不会执行命令。

## 字段一览

- `host.v2.mjs` — Host 半：状态机、HTTP 接口、命令派发、兜底页面。（`host.v1.mjs` 为上一版，保留以便回滚。）
- `client.js` — 浏览器半：设置页分区 + `shell.overlay` 浮层卡片（可拖动，`useDraggable` 负责指针捕获、边界夹取与位置持久化）。
- `cordis.patch.yml` — bundle 补丁：插入插件行与初始配置。

升级宿主半代码时换文件名（`host.v1.mjs` → `host.v2.mjs`）并同步 `package.json` 的 `main` / `exports`：config-only 热重载不会重新加载同一路径的模块。

plugins.description: A DSH settings page listing installed skills with per-skill enable switches and short summaries.
plugins.readme_text:
# dshx-skill-manager

> A Settings page that lists every installed skill with an on/off switch and a short AI-generated summary.

在 **设置 → 技能管理** 里列出 DSH 当前解析到的所有技能（用户级、项目级），每个技能一个开关，并附一句简短的中文概述。

- **开关**：插件在自身生命周期内包装技能注册表的 `snapshot()` / `get()`，停用的技能对模型目录、`skill` 工具和 `/skill` 命令都不可见。技能文件不会被修改，卸载插件即完全还原。
- **概述**：可用默认模型批量生成（带缓存，描述变化才重新生成）；没有 AI 概述时用描述的第一句。

## 配置（`cordis.patch.yml`）

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `summarize` | `true` | 是否用默认模型生成概述 |
| `summaryMaxChars` | `60` | 概述长度上限 |
| `stateFile` | 空 | 状态文件，默认 `$DSH_HOME/dshx-skill-manager/state.json` |

## 安装

```sh
# Web profile
dsh plugin --profile web add github:callaumyan-design/dshx-skill-manager
# Desktop（用 DSH Desktop 自带的 dsh 命令，先从托盘完全退出 Desktop）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:callaumyan-design/dshx-skill-manager
```

安装后重启 DSH。卸载：`dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dshx-skill-manager`。

## 兼容性

在 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2（desktop / web profile）上开发和使用。纯 JavaScript，无构建步骤，无安装脚本。

## License

MIT

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin - persistent four-layer cognitive memory for agents, backed by vecRecall
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-vecrecall

> **A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that gives your agent persistent, four-layer cognitive memory.**

The plugin mounts six `vecrecall_*` tools onto the harness tool registry, backed by
[vecRecall](https://github.com/snowfoxHQ/vecRecall) — a local-first, four-layer cognitive memory
engine (L0 identity / L1 key moments / L2 semantic / L3 deep retrieval) with hybrid retrieval,
meaning-level deduplication, and everything stored on your own disk.

Memory work happens in a **long-lived Python process** that holds the embedding model, so repeated
tool calls cost milliseconds instead of reloading weights every time.

## Install

```bash
# 1. Python side (vecRecall runtime). There is no PyPI package yet, so install from GitHub:
pip install "vecrecall @ git+https://github.com/snowfoxHQ/vecRecall.git"

# 2. Mount the plugin into a dsh profile
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-vecrecall
```

Then restart that profile. The tools appear as `vecrecall_*`.

## Tools

| Tool | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `vecrecall_remember` | Store a durable fact. Meaning-level dedup: near-duplicates merge instead of piling up. |
| `vecrecall_recall` | Pure semantic search. No results means a genuine miss — that is signal, not failure. |
| `vecrecall_context` | Build the four-layer bundle (L0/L1/L2/L3). Use at session start or when resuming a topic. |
| `vecrecall_list` | Structural listing by wing/topic. Also how you find an id to delete. |
| `vecrecall_forget` | Delete one memory by id or an unambiguous prefix. |
| `vecrecall_stats` | Store size and backend health. Cheap sanity check. |

Rules worth keeping in mind: `content` is stored **verbatim**, so write self-contained statements;
`summary` is display-only and never searched. Do not dump whole files or transient tool output into
memory.

## Configuration

Every field below has a working default; override only what you need in `cordis.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: vecrecall
      name: 'dsh-vecrecall'
      config:
        dataDir: '~/.vecrecall'      # where memories live, created on first start
        wing: 'default'              # namespace: a project, user, or domain
        embedder: 'auto'             # auto | bow | sentence | ollama | api
        python: 'python'             # interpreter used for the helper process
        chain: false                 # hash chain; ~2x storage, for tamper auditing
        startupTimeoutMs: 120000     # first start loads the embedding model
        toolTimeoutMs: 120000
        maxRenderChars: 8000         # cap rendered output to protect the context window
        onSensitive: redact       # redact | reject | allow; see "Credentials" below
```

`embedder: 'bow'` needs nothing extra and works fully offline; `'auto'` picks sentence-transformers
when installed and silently falls back to bag-of-words otherwise.

## Security

The helper service listens on `127.0.0.1` only and requires a random per-process bearer token. It is
never exposed on a network interface. Your memory store is plain files under `dataDir`.

### Credentials

Memories are stored as plain text, and retrieval requires embedding the plain text — so once a
secret lands in the store there is no way to recover. Encrypting it would mean giving up search.
The only reliable moment to act is before the write, so content is screened first:

| `onSensitive` | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| `redact` (default) | Replaces credential parts with `***`, keeps the rest |
| `reject` | Refuses the write and tells the model to strip the secret |
| `allow` | Stores content as-is (not recommended) |

Redaction preserves the retrievable meaning: `postgres://app:s3cret@db.internal:5432/hestia` is
stored as `postgres://app:***@db.internal:5432/hestia`, so "which host is the database on" still
recalls, while the password never touches disk.

This is pattern matching, not a mathematical guarantee — it will not catch a bare password with no
keyword context. The durable fix is upstream: keep credentials in env vars or a vault, and let the
agent reference only the variable name (`DB_URL`). The same guard runs inside the vecRecall engine,
so CLI and skill writes are covered too.

## Compatibility

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Verified against | `@deepseek-ai/cordis` 4.0.5, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 0.0.1-rc.1 |
| Type check | `npm run check` passes (strict, erasable-syntax-only) |
| Runtime | Python bridge smoke-tested end to end: cold start ~23s, then 20–120ms per call |
| Live harness run | verified on DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 (desktop app): tools registered, memory written and read back |

## Troubleshooting

**`vecRecall 调用失败：vecRecall 未安装或不可导入`** — the interpreter the plugin launches cannot
`import vecrecall`. If you installed into a virtualenv, point `python` at it:

```yaml
config:
  python: '/path/to/venv/bin/python'
```

**First tool call is slow** — expected: that call loads the embedding model. Everything after it is
fast, because the process stays alive for the lifetime of the plugin. Raise `startupTimeoutMs` if
your machine takes longer than 120s.

**Recalls back almost nothing** — you are likely on the bag-of-words fallback. Install
`sentence-transformers` and start numpy-based search, or set `embedder: 'sentence'`.

## Development

```bash
npm install
npm run check     # tsc --noEmit
```

`src/bridge.ts` owns the Python process, `src/tools.ts` declares the tools, `src/index.ts` is the
plugin entry (`apply(ctx)`).

Uses only erasable TypeScript so a plain `node` with type stripping can load it.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: 让 AI Agent 用一页石墨风格 HTML 回答复杂问题
plugins.readme_text:
English · 简体中文

Answer me with HTML
in Shimo Style

An agent skill that answers hard questions with a one-page HTML in Shimo Docs style.
Markdown in. One self-contained page out. No server, no build step.

Demo · Install · Theme · Development

The built-in shimo theme. Run am config set mode dark, or use the page toolbar, for the dark variant.

## Why this fork? [Answer me with HTML](https://github.com/QingYunA/answer-me-with-html) already turns a Markdown draft into one clean HTML page. This fork adds a **project-native Shimo Docs theme** and makes it the default, so every page looks like a document someone would actually read. | | Original | This fork | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | CLI, drafts, components, videos | ✅ | ✅ unchanged | | Themes | blueprint · shadcn · paper · 3b1b | + **`shimo`**, built in and default | | Look | technical board / cards / paper | white square page on `#f7f7f7`, 30px/700 title, 15px/1.7 body | | Quality | — | `0 errors · 0 warnings`, WCAG AA contrast | ## ✨ Features | Feature | What you get | | :--- | :--- | | 🎨 **Shimo Docs by default** | White page, thin gray rules, neutral grays and one accessible Shimo blue. | | 📄 **One file, offline** | The output is a single HTML file with inline CSS and JS. No server, no CDN. | | 🧩 **Real components** | Tables, code blocks, callouts, flow / sequence / ER diagrams, charts, timelines, trees and math. | | 🌗 **Light & dark** | Both palettes are token-driven and pass the theme's contrast checks. | | ⚡ **Fast** | The model writes a short Markdown draft; the bundled CLI does layout and SVG coordinates. | | 🧪 **Controlled writing** | The STE check flags wordy sentences and overlong paragraphs before the page is written. | ## 🚀 Install You need [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/) 20 or newer. There is no `npm install` step: the CLI is bundled inside the skill. ### Let your agent install it Paste this into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, DeepSeek Harness or another agent: > Install Answer me with HTML in Shimo Style: read > https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kanzakivnw/answer-me-with-html-in-Shimo-Style/main/INSTALL.md and follow it. ### One command ```bash npx skills add kanzakivnw/answer-me-with-html-in-Shimo-Style ``` The installer ([vercel-labs/skills](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills)) asks which agents to install into. ### Claude Code plugin ``` /plugin marketplace add kanzakivnw/answer-me-with-html-in-Shimo-Style /plugin install answer-me-with-html-in-shimo-style@answer-me-with-html-in-Shimo-Style ``` ### DeepSeek Harness plugin ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add github:kanzakivnw/answer-me-with-html-in-Shimo-Style ```
Manual install ```bash git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/kanzakivnw/answer-me-with-html-in-Shimo-Style.git /tmp/answer-me-with-html-in-shimo-style cp -R /tmp/answer-me-with-html-in-shimo-style/skills/answer-me-with-html-in-shimo-style ~/.claude/skills/answer-me-with-html-in-shimo-style ``` Other skill folders: Codex `~/.codex/skills/`, Cursor `~/.cursor/skills/`, OpenCode `~/.config/opencode/skill/`, DeepSeek Harness `~/.dsh/skills/`.
## 🧩 Use Ask a question the way you always do: ``` > Explain the TCP three-way handshake > Redis or Memcached for our cache? > Map out how the modules in this repo fit together ``` The agent writes a short Markdown draft and runs the bundled CLI. The page goes to `~/.answer-me-with-html/pages/` (the same data folder as the original project; install one or the other, because settings and pages are shared). Open it in a browser. Change settings with the agent (`config`), or directly: ```bash am config # show settings; theme defaults to shimo am config set theme auto # content-based theme choice am config set theme shimo # back to the Shimo Docs theme am config set mode dark # dark palette am list # templates, themes, components ``` On the page itself, the top-right toolbar switches theme and light/dark mode, opens comments, and copies the reply Markdown back to the agent. ## 🎨 The Shimo look The theme follows measurements from the Shimo editor (2026-10). Nothing is hand-waved: the tokens below are the same ones the theme checks and ships. | Element | Value | Where it shows | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | Canvas | `#f7f7f7` | page background | | Paper | `#ffffff` + `0 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.13)` | square page with a quiet shadow | | Title / body | `30px/700` · `15px/1.7` | document title and prose | | Ink | `#3a3a3a` · `#6b6b6b` · `#9a9a9a` | text, secondary text, metadata | | Rules | `#e7e7e7` · `#efefef` | table borders and hairlines | | Fill | `#f5f5f5` | table headers, code blocks, inline code | | Accent | `#2b68c2` | links, focus rings, highlights | | Diagram | `#d5dae1` strokes · `#eaf2fe` highlights | flow, sequence, ER, charts | The theme source is [`src/themes/shimo.js`](src/themes/shimo.js). A user theme with the same name in `~/.answer-me-with-html/themes/shimo.json` would shadow it; do not install one if you want the built-in version.
Doc template preview

## 🔄 How it works ```mermaid flowchart LR Q[Question] --> D[Markdown draft] D --> C[Bundled am CLI] C --> T[shimo theme tokens] T --> P[Single HTML page] ``` The model never writes HTML, CSS or SVG. It writes the draft; the CLI owns layout, colors, dark mode, diagram coordinates and the writing checks. ## 📁 Project layout ```text skills/answer-me-with-html-in-shimo-style/ the skill: SKILL.md, references and the bundled CLI src/themes/shimo.js the Shimo theme source (built into the CLI) demo/ the GitHub Pages demo (index.md → index.html) .github/workflows/pages.yml renders the demo and deploys it to Pages ``` ## 🛠 Development ```bash npm ci npm run build # rebuild skills/answer-me-with-html-in-shimo-style/scripts/am.mjs npm test ``` `skills/answer-me-with-html-in-shimo-style/scripts/am.mjs` is generated. Edit `src/`, then run `npm run build` and commit both. ## ⚖️ Credits & license Forked from [Answer me with HTML](https://github.com/QingYunA/answer-me-with-html) by QingYunA, MIT. Th

plugins.description: 记住 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版的窗口尺寸：重启后自动恢复、默认水平垂直居中，并提供设置页手动调整。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-window-size

**简体中文** · [English](README.en.md)

记住 **DeepSeek Harness 桌面版**的窗口尺寸：重启后自动恢复、默认水平垂直居中，并且可以在设置页里直接改，不用手动拖窗口。

![平台：Windows](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Windows-0078D4)
![宿主：DSH 桌面版](https://img.shields.io/badge/host-DSH%20Desktop-4f6ef7)
![许可证：MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)

- **首次启动**：没有记录时使用 **1440 × 900**，并居中。
- **每次手动调整**：自动记录，下次启动恢复。
- **默认居中**：每次启动都把窗口放在当前显示器工作区正中；可在设置页关闭，改为沿用上次位置。
- **不会记错**：最大化、最小化、隐藏状态一律不记录，避免下次以超大尺寸打开；恢复时会按当前显示器工作区收缩，换显示器也能用。
- **设置页**：`设置 → 窗口尺寸` 可手动设定尺寸、记住当前尺寸、立即居中、恢复默认。
- 在非桌面版 Host（`dsh` 命令行、服务器）上仍可加载，但设置页会提示不可用。

## 为什么必须做成 Host 插件

桌面版创建主窗口时把尺寸写死为 `1280 × 820`，也不持久化任何窗口状态。渲染端改不了它：在 Electron 里，`window.resizeTo()` 会被路由到 `WebContentsDelegate::SetContentsBounds`，Electron 只把它转发成 `content-bounds-updated` 事件，**并不会真的改变 `BrowserWindow` 的大小**。

所以真正干活的是 Host 进程：它通过 `koffi`（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop-host` 本来就依赖它）调用 `FindWindowExW` / `GetWindowRect` / `GetDpiForWindow` / `SetWindowPos`，并且**抢在窗口显示前**完成设置，避免先闪一下旧尺寸。

## 设置页

`设置 → 窗口尺寸` 是一个 `settings.section` 条目。页面上会显示当前窗口尺寸、已记录尺寸和上次动作（含时间），并提供：

| 控件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| 宽度 / 高度 + **应用并记住** | 立刻改变窗口尺寸并保存 |
| **记住当前尺寸** | 把你现在手动拖出来的尺寸存下来 |
| **重新应用** | 用记录值再应用一次（含当前居中设置） |
| **恢复默认** | 回到配置的默认 `1440 × 900` |
| **启动时居中** 开关 | 决定恢复时是否居中 |
| **立即居中** | 只居中，不改尺寸 |
| **启用尺寸记忆** 开关 | 关闭后既不恢复也不记录 |

页面本身不碰窗口，它通过包私有 RPC 通道 `/dsh-window-size` 调用 Host 端，Host 端用与启动恢复同一个控制器来执行。

## 安装

直接从 GitHub 安装（插件管理器里填写）：

```
github:home-i/dsh-window-size#v1.1.2
```

也可以在桌面版 **插件** 页里从本地目录安装。本地开发还可以把包链接进桌面版 profile：

```jsonc
// ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-window-size": "link:/path/to/dsh-window-size"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": ["...", "dsh-window-size"]
    }
  }
}
```

下次启动即生效，之后改动源码也不需要重装。

> 不要把这个 `link:` 换成手工建的 Windows junction 再执行 `pnpm install`：pnpm 安装时会移除该条目，而 Windows 会顺着 junction 进入目标目录，导致源码目录被清空。

## 配置

Loader 行里配置首次启动的默认值：

```yaml
# cordis.patch.yml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-window-size
      name: dsh-window-size
      config:
        width: 1440        # 首次启动宽度，CSS 像素
        height: 900        # 首次启动高度，CSS 像素
        center: true       # 每次恢复都居中
        enabled: true      # 是否启用恢复与记录
```

尺寸单位是 CSS 像素；宽高最小被限制为 `520 × 600`，恢复时还会被当前显示器工作区限制。

## 状态文件

记录放在 harness home 下，跟随 profile 而不是 Electron 的 `userData`：

```
~/.dsh/dsh-window-size/window-size.json
```

```json
{
  "size": { "width": 1440, "height": 900 },
  "center": true,
  "enabled": true,
  "last": { "action": "restore", "source": "remembered", "at": 0 },
  "updatedAt": 0
}
```

`last` 记录最近一次动作（`restore`、`resize`、`apply`、`remember`、`center`、`center-on`、`center-off`、`enabled`、`disabled`），包含实际达成的尺寸、DPI 缩放和窗口标题——设置页显示的就是它，出问题时也靠它定位。删除这个文件即回到配置默认值。旧版（只有 size + last）的记录会自动升级：尺寸保留，新开关取配置默认。

## RPC 约定

Host 在 Web carrier 上注册前缀路由，每个请求都先过 `connection.admit`，因此只有本 Host 的已认证页面能操作窗口：

```
POST /dsh-window-size/<endpoint>
content-type: application/json

{ "type": "client-request", "rpcId": "…", "method": "<endpoint>", "payload": … }
```

端点：`status`、`apply`（`{width,height}`）、`reapply`、`reset`、`center`、`remember`、`set-center`（`true|false`）、`set-enabled`（`true|false`）。返回使用 Connection 的 `server-response` 信封；业务失败以 HTTP 200 + `{ ok: false, error: { code, message, details } }` 返回，而路由不存在、非 POST、认证失败分别是 `404` / `405` / `401`。

## 文件

| 文件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `index.js` | Host 插件入口；启动控制器与 RPC，并负责释放 |
| `window-memory.js` | 控制器：查找窗口、恢复、居中、跟踪缩放、处理页面动作 |
| `rpc.js` | 前缀路由注册、认证、信封解析、端点分发 |
| `win32.js` | koffi 绑定、DPI、显示器工作区、窗口查找 |
| `state.js` | harness home 下的原子 JSON 记录 |
| `client.js` | 设置页（`settings.section`），中英双语 |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | bundle 层插入的 Loader 行 |

## 环境要求

- Windows 10/11 x64 或 arm64。
- DeepSeek Harness **桌面版**（Electron shell 的 Host 进程）。窗口 API 是 Win32 的，其它环境不生效。

## 常见问题

**包管理器操作时报 `dsh: cannot resolve profile bundle "dsh-window-size"`**：说明 manifest 里列了这个 bundle，但 `node_modules/dsh-window-size` 不存在、或其链接目标里没有 `package.json`。插件管理器的 reconcile 阶段对所有已列依赖都会严格解析、没有兜底（而启动时只是跳过并报告），补回链接或重装 bundle 即可恢复。

**设置页显示不可用**：当前 Host 不是桌面版，或 `koffi` / `user32` 加载失败；具体原因会显示在提示下方。

**窗口恢复后的尺寸不对**：查看状态文件里的 `last`，它记录了请求值、实际达成值、DPI 缩放与窗口标题。

## 许可证

[MIT](LICENSE) © home-i

---

[English version →](README.en.md)

# dsh-aesthete-agent

aesthete-agent(前端美学引擎)的 DeepSeek Harness 原生插件。

把配色决策从"凭感觉"变成"凭检查":118 块实证色板按语域选板,四道机械检查——对比度、色盲模拟、AI 味检测、五维评分——检查不过不交付。全部本地运行,零联网,零 API 密钥(引擎为纯 Python 标准库,需要本机装有 Python 3.8+)。

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:docsor1212/dsh-aesthete-agent
```

无头模式把 `--profile web` 换成 `--profile headless`。

## 原生工具(17 个)

| 工具 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `aesthete_match` | 按需求自然语言在实证库选板,自动识别语域(素雅/大气/鲜艳/科技感/国风水墨…) |
| `aesthete_directions` | 跨语域方向对比:整页渲染并排,差异铁律,选择回传句 |
| `aesthete_report` | 四道机械检查一键验收,PASS/FAIL 即裁决 |
| `aesthete_matrix` | 全对对比度矩阵+最佳文字/底色配对 |
| `aesthete_blind` | 红绿蓝三型色盲模拟与碰撞风险 |
| `aesthete_score` | 五维评分卡(/20)与修复建议 |
| `aesthete_evidence` | 页面证据卷宗:四闸+静态审计合成验收记录 |
| `aesthete_visualize` | 色板套进 10 类真实 UI 场景渲染自审 |
| `aesthete_recipes` | 表现力技法库:14 条可组合惊艳配方,整页设计前必取 |
| `aesthete_scene` | showcase 级单场景(设备框+证据徽章),紫域守门内置 |
| `aesthete_scaffold` | 四幕明暗旅程整页骨架,对比度自动调墨 |
| `aesthete_tokens` | 全套语义设计令牌(CSS+JSON):墨色自动调墨,强调拆图形/文字双档 |
| `aesthete_audit` | 已有页面机械体检:漂移/渐变/对比对带可执行修复值 |
| `aesthete_chartpal` | 图表用色三型派生:分类/顺序/发散,色盲区分度验证 |
| `aesthete_typescale` | CJK 友好模块字阶:12px 下限,行高配对,tabular-nums |
| `aesthete_qc` | 渲染对账:截图对声明令牌核对大底真伪与板外入侵 |
| `aesthete_narrate` | 量化叙事:实测数字转双语说明,每个数字可溯源 |

自然语言即可触发,无需记命令:"给这个页面配色打个分""要素雅耐看的,出三个方向对比""用 Deep Pine 出一页,再对截图跑渲染对账"。

## 工作流建议

1. **选板**:用 `aesthete_match` 说需求,或 `aesthete_directions` 出跨语域方向对比页,用户点名后按回传句继续;
2. **构图**:`aesthete_recipes` 取技法,挑 3-5 条自由组合;快速起点用 `aesthete_scaffold`/`aesthete_scene`,令牌接线用 `aesthete_tokens`;
3. **验收**:交付前 `aesthete_report`/`aesthete_evidence`,宿主有浏览器工具时对截图跑 `aesthete_qc` 渲染对账,PASS 才交付;
4. **转述**:需要向客户解释"为什么这样配"时,`aesthete_narrate` 出双语纯数字说明。

## 斜杠命令(7 条)

/aesthete-status(自检+台账) · /aesthete-report · /aesthete-match · /aesthete-score · /aesthete-directions · /aesthete-tokens · /aesthete-audit

## 上游

- 引擎与技能本体:[docsor1212/aesthete-agent](https://github.com/docsor1212/aesthete-agent)(MIT)
- 在线演示:https://docsor.cn/aesthete/

## 安全声明(供安装前审查)

- **零联网**:引擎为纯 Python 标准库,安装后与运行全程不发起任何网络请求;
- **子进程**:仅调用本机 `python3`/`python` 执行随插件捆绑的引擎脚本,无其他可执行文件;
- **无安装期脚本**:package.json 不含任何 lifecycle scripts(preinstall/postinstall 等);
- **不读凭据**:不触碰 shell 历史、密钥、浏览器数据;
- **写盘范围**:仅当前工作目录(tokens.css / chartpal.html / *.narration.md / *.evidence.json 等)。

## License

MIT

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin for the DSH Mobile Android app: QR pairing, DSH on your phone, answer approvals from notifications.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Mobile — host plugin for DeepSeek Harness

English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) | [日本語](README.ja.md)

`@kinocode/dsh-mobile` is a DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin for the DSH Mobile Android app. It lets you:

- Pair your phone by scanning a QR code in the DSH sidebar.
- Use the regular DSH web UI on your phone through an HTTPS gateway running on your computer.
- On phones, let the session title use the available header width and tap it to see the full title. Only the session header reserves space for the floating navigation buttons.
- Answer approval requests and agent questions from notifications in the live desktop session (the first answer from any device wins).
- Receive a notification when a watched session finishes its turn.

The Android app is distributed separately and is not part of this repository. This is an unofficial project, not affiliated with DeepSeek.

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0`. The range is pinned because the plugin relies on internal DSH Gateway APIs that are not yet stable.
- The DSH web server (`webserver` service), included with DSH Desktop.
- Node.js 22.4 or later (the runtime bundled with DSH Desktop works).
- Phone and computer on the same network, or both on [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com/).
- For notifications: a relay server (see [Notifications and the relay](#notifications-and-the-relay)).

## Install

Add `@kinocode/dsh-mobile` on the DSH Plugins page, or run:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @kinocode/dsh-mobile
```

Restart DSH. The log should show `[mobile-bridge] gateway listening {"origins":[...]}`.

## Pair a phone

1. Click **スマホを接続** ("Connect phone") at the bottom of the DSH sidebar.
2. In the app, tap **QR を読み取る** ("Scan QR") and scan the code. If you do not have a camera, use **リンクをコピー** ("Copy link") and paste the link into the app.
3. The code is single-use and expires after 5 minutes. Click **新しい QR** ("New QR") to generate another.

The panel also lists paired phones and lets you remove them. Removing a phone revokes its access immediately. The panel is currently available only in Japanese.

On the phone, the DSH sidebar is hidden so the conversation gets the full width. The round button at the top left opens it over the conversation; picking a session or tapping outside closes it. Desktop-only buttons are hidden.

When you add a workspace on the phone, the computer's folders are listed on the phone instead of opening a folder dialog on the computer. Browse to a folder or type its path, then tap **このフォルダを使う** ("Use this folder").

The right sidebar (files, preview, changes review, browser, terminal) opens full screen on the phone. Buttons that open an app or Finder on the computer are hidden on the phone; the file preview offers **スマホに保存** ("Save to phone") instead, which saves to the phone's Downloads. If the page stays blank after DSH restarts, it reloads by itself.

The round buttons at the top left (sidebar) and top right (right sidebar) can be moved anywhere: long-press one, then drag it.

In DSH's built-in browser (the right sidebar's Browser), words that are not an address are searched: Google on the desktop, Bing on the phone. The phone can only show pages that allow being framed (Google and others refuse), so ↗ (Open in system browser) opens the page in Chrome.

## Configuration

All fields are optional. Add them to your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. A profile patch replaces the plugin's entire configuration, so include every field you want to keep.

```yaml
- id: mobile-bridge
  config:
    relayUrl: https://relay.example.com
    relayEnrollToken: '...'
```

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `relayUrl` | `''` (off) | Relay used for notifications and answering from them. |
| `relayEnrollToken` | `''` | Token for a relay that only accepts known computers. |
| `gatewayEnabled` | `true` | Run the HTTPS gateway for phones. |
| `gatewayPort` | `3543` | Gateway port (1024–65535). |
| `gatewayHosts` | detected | IPv4 addresses to listen on. Only private addresses are accepted (see below). |
| `hostLabel` | computer name | Name shown on the phone. |
| `previewMaxChars` | `400` | Longest command preview shown in the app (50–4000). |
| `stateDir` | `$DSH_HOME/mobile-bridge` | Absolute path for host identity, paired devices, and certificates. `$DSH_HOME` defaults to `~/.dsh`. |

The configuration ID `mobile-bridge` and log name `dsh-mobile-bridge` are kept for compatibility with earlier versions.

## Phone history loading

Only the phone gateway limits opening history to 40 messages, targeting the latest 10 messages and one turn. Older-page loading remains unchanged. These budgets count user/assistant messages, not tool events or bytes. No DSH core or desktop changes are required.

An authenticated app-shell script saves opening snapshots in IndexedDB. Reopening the same host/device/session advertises verified SHA-256 record hashes; the gateway sends references for matching records and full data for misses. The browser reconstructs the authoritative snapshot before the stock client sees it. Cursor, projections, header, and assistant-stream baseline always come from the current server snapshot, never an optimistic cached replay. Reading the host's log still uses stock DSH; this optimization reduces phone transfer and initial history size, not host disk work.

Only records of at least 256 serialized UTF-8 bytes are advertised, with the hash property limited to 8KiB. If none qualify, no manifest is uploaded. Delta selection accounts for manifest upload as well as download savings. A complete cache miss can still incur the already-uploaded manifest overhead; total traffic is not guaranteed to shrink in every case.

Relay writes are serialized with source pause/resume while the destination drains. Buffered data exceeding 64MiB no longer causes termination. Stock WebSocket's 100MiB per-frame limit still applies; the message-count budget is not a byte limit.

The cache retains opening snapshots only, bounded globally to 12 sessions and 8MiB with a seven-day reuse expiry. Expired entries are removed during a later save/trim; physical deletion while the app is inactive is not guaranteed. It contains conversation text and tool results. On shared devices set `historyCacheEnabled: false` to stop persistence/reuse; this does not erase existing records. Clear the app/WebView's stored data in Android settings to erase them (pairing may need repeating). Revoking a device blocks connections and cache reuse, but does not remotely erase stored data. Storage denial falls back to online loading; a missing reference invalidates that cache entry and reconnects for a full snapshot. Storage is origin-specific, so changing LAN addresses causes a cold load; a stable Tailscale origin improves reuse.

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `historyEnabled` | `true` | Optimize phone history; false restores stock transport. |
| `historyCacheEnabled` | `true` | Save/reuse device history independently of opening-page sizing. |
| `historyMaxMessages` | `40` | Opening cap, integer 1–500. |
| `historyMinMessages` | `10` | Recent messages before turn alignment, integer 1–cap; defaults to the smaller cap when below 10. |

Restart the DSH process loading this plugin, then reload the phone screen. Run `node --test test/*.test.mjs` for unit/TLS lifecycle tests. For a real Chromium persistence/reload/delta smoke, supply Playwright with `PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE=/absolute/path/to/playwright/index.mjs node test/history-browser.smoke.mjs`; optionally set `CHROME_PATH` to the Chrome executable.

## How it works

- **Gateway.** The HTTPS server listens only on private IPv4 addresses: `10/8`, `172.16/12`, `192.168/16`, and Tailscale's `100.64/10`. Certificates come from a CA created by the plugin. The QR code contains the CA fingerprint, so the app trusts only that CA for this computer.
- **Pairing.** The app generates an ECDSA P-256 key in the Android Keystore and registers the public key using the one-time code.
- **Control requests.** Requests for the pending list, answers, and settings are signed with the device key. The plugin verifies the signature, a timestamp (±5 minutes), and

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin that predicts your next message after each reply. Press Tab to accept it as an editable draft; it never sends by itself.
plugins.readme_text:
# Followup Prompt English | [中文](README.zh.md) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-followup-prompt)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-followup-prompt) [![CI](https://github.com/keliwang/dsh-followup-prompt/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/keliwang/dsh-followup-prompt/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) > Predicts your next message in [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). Press Tab to use it; it never sends by itself. After each reply, the plugin guesses what you are most likely to say next and shows it as gray text inside the empty composer. Press **Tab** to turn it into an editable draft, or just start typing and it disappears. - **Unobtrusive**: appears only when the composer is empty; failures and timeouts show nothing and never raise an error. - **You stay in control**: a prediction is only a draft. You always send it yourself. - **Works out of the box**: uses the current session's model by default, with no extra dependencies or services. ## Contents - [Installation](#installation) - [Usage](#usage) - [How it works](#how-it-works) - [Configuration](#configuration) - [FAQ](#faq) - [Upgrade and uninstall](#upgrade-and-uninstall) - [Development](#development) ## Installation Requires DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0` (verified on 0.2.1-rc.2) with at least one model configured. **Harness Desktop (Windows, macOS)** 1. In the sidebar, open **Plugins** → **Add plugin**. 2. Enter `dsh-followup-prompt` as the **Package name or address**. In mainland China, set **Registry** to **Mainland China mirror**. 3. Click **Install**, then **Enable now**, and reload the page. If you are told to restart DSH, quit Harness completely and open it again. If npm is unreachable, step 2 also accepts the full path of a `dsh-followup-prompt-.tgz` downloaded from [Releases](https://github.com/keliwang/dsh-followup-prompt/releases). **Harness Web (Windows, macOS, Linux)** Requires Node.js `22.19` or later and pnpm. ```sh npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.2 plugin --profile web add dsh-followup-prompt npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.2 web ``` > [!NOTE] > Do not install from the source directory (entering this repository's path as the package address). A directory install cannot find the dependencies that ship with Harness, so the plugin fails to load. To build locally, run `pnpm pack` in this repository and install the resulting `.tgz`. **Verify the installation**: ask a question, wait for the reply to finish, and leave the composer empty. Gray prediction text appears in the composer; press Tab and the text moves into the composer **without being sent**. If no prediction appears, see the [FAQ](#faq). ## Usage When a reply finishes and the composer is empty, the prediction appears where the placeholder would be. | Action | Effect | |---|---| | **Tab** | The prediction becomes a draft in the composer with the cursor at the end, ready to edit | | **Esc** | Closes this prediction; it does not come back for this turn | | Start typing or composing with an input method | The prediction hides; once the composer is cleared, a prediction that was already generated reappears | | Start a new turn or switch sessions | The prediction hides | Reopening a finished session also shows the prediction for its last turn. ## How it works **When the model is called**: only while you are looking at a session whose turn has finished and the composer is empty. The result stays in memory until the next turn starts, so viewing it again is not billed again. Interrupted or failed turns, empty sessions, and subagent sessions are never predicted for. **What the model receives**: a "condensed transcript". Each turn keeps only your message and the visible text of the model's reply; thinking, tool calls, tool output, and the main conversation's system prompt are left out. Each turn appends just one pair of messages at the end, so the provider's prefix cache builds up turn after turn and most input tokens are billed at the cached rate. **Sticks to what's in the conversation**: predictions are instructed to use only names, values, and facts that appear in the condensed transcript. They shouldn't make up hostnames, IDs, commands, or results, or say you've already done something (like "restarted it, still failing") that your own messages don't mention. When the natural next message depends on something the model can't see, you get a more general suggestion, or none at all. This is best effort, not a guarantee, so read a prediction before you send it. **Cost**: every prediction is an ordinary model request billed by your provider. If you don't want it, switch the plugin off on the Plugins page; to spend less, give predictions their own cheaper model (`provider` / `model`). **Privacy** - Data goes only to the current session's model, or to the model you set with `provider` / `model`. Nothing is reported to any third party. - Predictions live in memory only. They are never written to the session log or to disk, and are gone after a restart. - Logs record metadata only (latency, token counts, outcome), never conversation content. - There is no server-side content moderation. Predictions that look like secrets are dropped locally, and you always send a prediction yourself. ## Configuration On the **Plugins** page, find **Followup Prompt** in the **Installed** list and click its configure button to open the settings. Click **Save** when you're done; changes take effect right away, no restart needed. The **Model** list shows the models you have already set up in DSH, the same ones you see when switching models in the composer. Pick **Session default** to use whatever model your current session is running. To turn the plugin off, use the switch on its row in the Plugins list. If you are comfortable with profile patches, you can also edit this plugin's `config` directly. > [!IMPORTANT] > `config` in a patch is replaced as a whole, not merged. When editing by hand, write out every field even to change one; use this package's [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml) as a reference. Saving from the settings page also rewrites the whole `config`. | Field | Default | Description | |---|---|---| | `provider` / `model` | `''` / `''` | The model used for predictions; both must be set together. Leave empty to follow the current session's model. Same as the **Model** option on the settings page. | | `reasoningEffort` | `'low'` | One of `''`, `off`, `low`, `high`, `max`. `''` uses the model's default; the session's own setting is never inherited. | | `maxTokens` | `8192` | Output token limit, reasoning tokens included. Actual output is usually short; the default leaves room for thinking. | | `timeoutMs` | `30000` | Timeout for one prediction, 2–30 seconds. | | `prompt` | `''` | Advanced: replaces the built-in prediction instruction. | ## FAQ
No prediction ever appears - On the **Plugins** page, check that the plugin's switch is on. - With non-DeepSeek models, `reasoningEffort: 'low'` may not be supported; change it to `''`. - A prediction is given up when the model takes longer than `timeoutMs`; try a faster model or a lower `reasoningEffort`. - Predictions are not shown while the composer contains text or attachments.
Tab does nothing While the slash-command menu or another popup menu is open, Tab belongs to the menu. Close the menu and press Tab again.
The prediction is misaligned Where the prediction is drawn depends on the internal structure of the Harness composer, which can shift after a Harness upgrade. Please open an issue; until it is fixed, switch the plugin off on the Plugins page.
An older version was installed Harness installs plugins with pnpm, which by default holds back versions published very recently (`minimumReleaseAge`) and installs the previous version instead; the install result shows the version actually installed. Wait a while, then reinstall follo

# dsh-webdav-sync

用 WebDAV 在多台电脑之间同步 DSH 的配置。备份在**离开本机之前**就用口令封好（AES-256-GCM + PBKDF2-SHA256，600000 轮），所以服务器上自始至终只有一个密文文件 —— 它看不到你的模型目录、插件清单、API 密钥，也看不到密钥属于哪个供应商。

同步的内容是 DSH profile 里的这几样：

| 份（`Part`） | 取自 | 中文名 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `models` | 最后生效的 `llm-pi-ai` 行：`cordis.patch.yml`，或遮住它的 `$DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml` | 模型供应商与模型 |
| `patch` | `cordis.patch.yml` 里其余的 loader 行（MCP、权限预设、UI 设置、insert 块……） | 其余 profile 配置 |
| `plugins` | `package.json` 的 `dependencies` 与 `dsh.profile.bundles` | 已安装插件 |
| `dirs` | 你在「同步内容」里**选择**的目录（profile 之外的绝对路径） | 附加目录 |
| `keys` | DSH 凭据服务里、被上面几份点名的那些 API 密钥 | API 密钥 |

模型配置按 Loader 的覆盖顺序取**最后一个带 `config` 的适用 `llm-pi-ai` 行**；后面的 `disabled` 等元数据行不遮蔽前面的配置。同步保留该配置中 `providers` 的键序和显式 `models` 数组的顺序。宿主界面另有账号/官方供应商优先、内置目录顺序等展示规则；纯 provider 重排也可能要重启 DSH 才反映到运行中的列表。未显式配置模型列表时，列表来自各自宿主的内置目录，目录版本不同仍可能显示不同顺序（[0065](docs/decisions/0065-effective-model-overrides.md)）。

DSH 还会把 `$DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml`（家目录覆盖层）排在 profile 的 patch **之后**，并对 `config` 整体替换：那层若有带 `config` 的 `llm-pi-ai` 行，它才是真正生效的清单，profile 里同步来的那份会被整行遮住 —— 这正是「同步过去、重启也还是旧顺序」的原因。所以模型份按**最后生效的层**读写：家层是唯一的清单时（profile 里没有）写进家层；两层都有时，把那行从家层删掉（删之前先封进 `sync/`），让 profile 里同步过来的那行重新生效，一份清单只留一个主人（[0071](docs/decisions/0071-sync-the-catalog-where-it-takes-effect.md)）。

每台电脑各改各的，同步时按份做三方合并，冲突时新的那份胜出、旧的那份留档；服务器上永远只有一份「整个 setup」的版本，而不是 profile 的镜像。

前三份切自 profile 的两个文件，`dirs` 与 `keys` 各是一份自己的东西。`dirs` 是让你把 profile 之外的目录（笔记、提示词、脚本）也带上：在「同步内容」里点附加目录那一行名称右边的**选择目录**（一个不带框的文字按钮），挑一个目录 —— 它连里面的文件一起封进同一个备份，在另一台电脑上恢复时**写回同一个路径**。它只增不减：同步会写会覆盖，但永远不会删掉里面的文件；这一行和其余四份一样有自己的开关（关掉只是「这台不带」，谁也删不掉），详见 [0036](docs/decisions/0036-extra-directories-part.md)。它的开关默认是**关**：目录整份带走，没点名要带之前不动它。

默认模型那一份（`cordis.patch.yml` 的 `agent-default-model` 行）**不在同步内容里**：换一次模型就换一次这一行，带着它只会让每次换模型都成为一次「本机有改动」的同步，而这一行本身没有多少值得跨机同步的东西。它留在各自的电脑上 —— 收集 patch 份时和本插件自己的 loader 行一样被排除（[0056](docs/decisions/0056-drop-default-model-part.md)）。

`keys` 补的是 profile 与「能用的配置」之间的那道缝：DSH 的 profile 里从来不存密钥，只存密钥的**名字**（`apiKeyEnv` / `secretEnv`），真值在本机的凭据服务里（`$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`）。只同步 profile 的话，另一台电脑会拿到一份完整的供应商列表，然后每个 provider 都报 `MISSING_CREDENTIAL`。这一份把名字对应的值一起带走，同样用口令封在文件里；名字从即将发出的那几份配置里读出来，所以密钥跟着点它名的那一份走。只发**托管存储**里的值（环境导出的不发），**只写不删**，两边都改过时本机赢（凭据没有 mtime，比不出谁新）。详见 [0054](docs/decisions/0054-sync-api-keys.md)。

---

## 参考与来源

设计来自 [magpie](https://github.com/yetone/magpie) 的 `internal/davsync`：同样是「一份密封文件 + 按份三方合并」的思路，本仓库把它移植到 TypeScript 并改成同步 DSH 的配置。

保留了的部分：

- **一份文件而不是镜像**：服务端只存整个 setup 的一个版本（`Bundle`），不是逐文件的目录镜像。
- **按份三方合并**：每个份单独哈希，改一份不会拖着别的份一起走。
- **新者胜 + 败者留档**：两边都改过时保留较新的，另一份写进本机 `sync/` 目录。
- **保守的写入**：读取记录的版本用于 `If-Match`，别的电脑在这中间写过就会被拒绝而不是被静默覆盖。

适配的部分：

- **Go → TypeScript**：一次同步按需进行 HTTP 往返与文件读写；可选的本机转发开启后另有一个随 Host 运行的回环监听器。
- **同步对象改成 DSH profile 行**：magpie 同步的是它自己的配置面；这里同步的是 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 loader 行和 profile 的 `package.json`，所以多了一层 YAML 文档级合并（保留注释、缩进与引号）。
- **`node_modules` 不参与同步**：只同步声明，包在同一台机器上用 pnpm 重新装（见「插件为什么不整目录同步」）。

---

## 安装

这是一个 DSH 插件，由 Host 半边（Node 侧）和浏览器半边（设置卡片）组成。装到 profile 里：

```bash
# 在 profile 目录里（$DSH_PROFILE_DIR，或 $DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>）
pnpm add dsh-webdav-sync
```

然后在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里加上本插件自己的 loader 行：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-webdav-sync
      name: 'dsh-webdav-sync'
```

`id` 是配置表单寻址用的 composition entry id（浏览器半边里的 `PLUGIN_ENTRY_ID` 与它一致），`name` 必须等于已安装的包名 —— 浏览器 bundle 按这个名字注册。上面这段就是包内 `cordis.patch.yml` 的全部内容（`package.json` 的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 指向它），所以走 DSH 的 bundle 机制安装时会带上这一行；手动装则需要自己加。

包信息：`dsh-webdav-sync`，版本 `0.1.0`，MIT。

装好后重新加载界面，Settings 里会出现「WebDAV 同步」一页，Plugins 页上对应这张卡片也会出现。

---

## 配置项

配置存在 profile 的 `.dsh-webdav-sync/sync.json`（权限 `0600`），不在 `cordis.patch.yml` 里。下表是 `SyncConfig`（`src/wire.ts`）的全部字段：

| 字段 | 类型 | 默认值 | 含义 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `url` | `string` | `''` | WebDAV 地址。填**文件夹地址本身**，例如坚果云 `https://dav.jianguoyun.com/dav/` 或 Nextcloud `https://…/remote.php/dav/files/<用户名>/`；也可以直接填服务器根（`https://dav.example.com`、`http://192.168.1.10:5005`），带不带尾斜杠都行 |
| `user` | `string` | `''` | WebDAV 用户名 |
| `password` | `string` | `''` | WebDAV 密码。发送给服务器（HTTP Basic） |
| `passphrase` | `string` | `''` | 加密口令。**只在本机用**，加密在文件离开本机之前完成；不得与 `password` 相同 |
| `autoEvery` | `number` | `-1` | 自动同步间隔（分钟）。取值来自 `AUTO_CHOICES = [-1, 3, 15, 30, 60]`；`-1`（`AUTO_MANUAL`）表示只在手动点「立即同步」时同步 |
| `models` | `boolean` | `true` | 是否同步模型供应商与模型这一份 |
| `plugins` | `boolean` | `true` | 是否同步已安装插件这一份 |
| `patch` | `boolean` | `true` | 是否同步其余 profile 配置这一份 |
| `keys` | `boolean` | `true` | 是否同步 API 密钥这一份。关掉之后这台电脑不读也不写任何密钥，服务器上那份原样带过 —— 只是「这台不带」，不是「删掉它」。旧配置里没有这个键，读作开 |
| `dirs` | `string[]` | `[]` | 附加目录的绝对路径，按你添加的顺序。列表说「同步哪几个」，开关说「这台带不带」。去掉一个就是「这台不再同步它」（文件不会动）。最多 `DIRS_MAX = 5` 个，每个目录最多 2000 个文件 / 8 MiB，路径必须是绝对的 |
| `dirsEnabled` | `boolean` | `false` | 附加目录这一份的开关，默认关。关掉之后这台电脑不读也不写任何附加目录，列表原样留着，服务器上那份也不动。旧配置里没有这个键，读作关 —— 目录整份带走，默认不动它 |
| `rememberPassword` | `boolean` | `true` | 是否把上游 WebDAV 密码留到下次。关掉后保存到磁盘的 `password` 为空，本次运行仍用内存里的密码；重启 Host 后需重新输入。不影响下面生成的本地转发账号 |
| `headers` | `string` | `''` | 额外请求头，一行一条「名字: 值」，空行与 `#` 开头的行忽略。先于每个请求自带的头写入，同名时以请求自带的为准；给了自己的 `authorization` 就不再补 Basic。同步与本机转发共用。明文，见下节 |
| `relayEnabled` | `boolean` | `false` | 本机转发开关。复用本表的 `url`、`user`、`password`、`headers`，与主表单一起保存；关掉只停止监听，保留端口与本地账号 |
| `relayPort` | `number` | `3426` | 只在 `127.0.0.1` 监听的端口，持久化而非每次启动随机分配；用「换一个端口」显式修改后按同一个「保存」生效 |
| `relayUser` | `string` | `''` | 首次开启转发并保存时生成的本地 Basic 用户名，之后沿用；保存在本机，不上传 |
| `relayPassword` | `string` | `''` | 与 `relayUser` 一起生成并保存的本地 Basic 密码，卡片显示且可复制；不是上游 WebDAV 密码，不受 `rememberPassword` 开关影响 |

对应 JSON 长这样：

```json
{
  "url": "https://dav.jianguoyun.com/dav/",
  "user": "me@example.com",
  "password": "…",
  "passphrase": "…",
  "autoEvery": 15,
  "models": true,
  "plugins": true,
  "patch": true,
  "keys": true,
  "dirs": [],
  "dirsEnabled": false,
  "rememberPassword": true,
  "headers": "",
  "relayEnabled": false,
  "relayPort": 3426,
  "relayUser": "",
  "relayPassword": ""
}
```

### 密码和口令存在哪里

`password` 与 `passphrase` 平时只存在两处：

1. `<profileDir>/.dsh-webdav-sync/sync.json`，mode `0600`（目录本身 `0700`）。
2. 运行中的 Host 进程内存里。

关掉「记住密码」之后，第 1 处不再有 `password` —— 它只留在第 2 处，直到 Host 退出。这不是「不用了」，而是「这次运行照样能用、重启 Host 后要重新输」：每条路由都是重新从磁盘读配置建引擎的，密码若在磁盘上被清空，同一个进程里的同步就会拿一个空密码去认证。见 [0019](docs/decisions/0019-session-password-not-remembered.md)。

**它们永远不会被写进 `cordis.patch.yml`。** 原因是 patch 文件本身就是被同步的几份之一 —— 放进去的密码会被下一个同步打包加密、上传到服务器。同理，插件自己的 loader 行在收集 patch 份时被排除（`SELF_ID = 'dsh-webdav-sync'`），所以这一行不会在机器之间来回跑。

**它们也永远不会下发到浏览器。** 卡片拿到的是 `ConfigView`，其中只有 `passwordSet` / `passphraseSet` 两个布尔值。表单里留空提交的含义是「沿用已存的那一个」（`ConfigureBody` 的约定），不是清空 —— 卡片从来没有能力把一个它从未见过的密钥写回去。

**但「沿用」只在同一个账号内成立。** 保存时会把地址与用户名跟上一份配置比一次（`sameAccount`）：地址或用户名变了、而这次提交又没有给出新密码，那个沿用的密码会被丢掉，而不是跟着发到新服务器上。`normaliseUrl` 会吸收末尾斜杠与空白，所以把同一个地址重粘一遍不算换账号。同一次提交里填的新密码不受影响 —— 它是为新地址给的。口令（`passphrase`）不参与这个判断：它只在本机解密，从来不会被发给任何服务器，所以没有「被发到别的服务」这条路径。见 [0015](docs/decisions/0015-password-not-carried-across-accounts.md)。

**「口令不能等于 WebDAV 密码」这条规矩比的是实际会发出去的那个密码**，包括「不记住密码」时留在内存里的那一个。服务器收到密码就能用它打开这份备份，所以这种情况下口令等于等于没设加密 —— 换句话说这条守卫不能因为密码没落盘就被绕过。手上根本没有密码时（例如新机器用新口令加入），这条规矩无话可说，不会拦。见 [0019](docs/decisions/0019-session-password-not-remembered.md)。

要清掉存下来的密码，用「关闭同步」：`turnOff()` 保存的是 `{ ...config, url: '', password: '' }`。值得注意的是它**不清口令**，也**不清状态**（不是 `saveState` 而是 `saveConfig`）—— 重新填回同一地址时 `stateKey` 会变回原值，那条基线仍然算数，所以「关掉又打开」不会被当成加入一个新文件夹，也就不会拿服务器上的旧 setup 覆盖本机较新的那份。

### 额外请求头

有的 WebDAV 服务器除了 Basic 认证还要别的东西：InfiniCLOUD 之类要 `User-Agent`，套在反向代理后面的要 `X-Api-Key`，也有的直接发 Bearer 令牌。`headers` 就是给这种情况的：

- **一行一条 `名字: 值`**，空行与 `#` 开头的行忽略。名字按 HTTP 的 token 规则校验，写坏的行会在**保存时**就被拒（错误里带行号），而不是等到下一次同步才以一个莫名其妙的 400 失败。
- **先写入，再让每个请求盖过它。** 请求自带的头（`if-match`、`if-none-match`、`content-type`、`depth`、`accept-encoding`）随后写入，同名时以请求自带的为准 —— 否则一个手滑的 `content-type` 就能把上传变成另一种类型，而 412 条件写入也会失效。
- **给了 `authorization` 就不再补 Basic。** 没给才用上面那个 `password` 拼 `Authorization: Basic …`，所以 Bearer 能用，而填了密码的配置行为不变。
- **它不算机密。** 与 `password` / `passphrase` 不同，它明文存在 `sync.json` 里，也明文下发到卡片（表单里可直接编辑）。但它也不进 `stateKey`：换请求头只是换了同一把锁的开门方式，那条「上次同步到哪」的基线描述的还是同一个文件。见 [0034](docs/decisions/0034-extra-request-headers.md)。

---

plugins.readme_text:
# @dsh-gis/dsh-opengis-skill

> **English summary** — A DeepSeek Harness bundle that packages the `gis/` skills of
> [opengis-skills](https://github.com/znlgis/opengis-skills) as installable, toggleable skills.
> The session catalog lists names and descriptions only; skill bodies and their
> `reference/*.md` files are loaded on demand, and every body carries DeepSeek Harness
> execution guidance (tool mapping, version probes, verification, permissions). Zero
> runtime dependencies: every asset ships inside the npm package.
>
> Compatibility: DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`; Node.js `>=22` for development
> only. MIT licensed.

DeepSeek Harness 的 **OpenGIS 技能包插件**：把 [opengis-skills](https://github.com/znlgis/opengis-skills) 中 `gis/` 分类的 GIS 技能打包成可安装、可启停的 DSH bundle。会话技能目录只列出名称与描述，技能正文与参考资料按需加载。

## 特性

- **覆盖 GIS 全链路**：GDAL、GDAL API、QGIS（qgis_process / PyQGIS / QGIS Server）、GeoServer（含 REST API 与 Cloud）、MapServer、PostGIS、PROJ、PDAL、GRASS GIS、JTS、NetTopologySuite、Esri Geometry API（Java/.NET）、Shapely、GeoPandas、GeoPipeAgent、OpenGisDAF、CesiumJS、OpenLayers、Leaflet、Mapbox GL JS、deck.gl、SharpMap、Mapsui、GeoTools、OpenGIS Utils（Java/.NET），以及 `opengis-all` 全流程索引。
- **按需加载**：注册的是 skill provider（`ctx.skills.registerProvider`），发现阶段只读 frontmatter；正文每次加载时读取，参考资料（`reference/*.md`）通过技能目录（resource base）相对解析。
- **零运行时依赖**：只用 Node 内置模块，不 import DSH 内部包；全部资产随 npm 包分发，整个包解包后约 720 kB。
- **可同步上游**：`npm run sync` 从 opengis-skills 检出复制资产，记录上游 commit 与每个文件的 SHA-256 到 `upstream.json`，并重新生成本文下方技能清单。
- **可启停**：单包同时是 bundle 与插件（`dsh.bundle.patch` 插入自身行），在 Plugins 里启用/停用即可。
- **面向 DSH 的执行建议**：每个技能末尾都有 `## DeepSeek Harness 使用建议`，写明如何按需读 reference、Windows 下如何映射 shell 命令、先跑哪个版本探测命令、如何重新打开产物验证，以及哪些安装/覆盖/凭据操作要先确认。

## 兼容性

- **DeepSeek Harness**：`>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`（`package.json` 的 `engines.dsh`）。本包通过 Host 提供的 `ctx.skills` 注册 provider，遵循 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill` 的 registry API 与 candidate/definition 契约；该契约在 0.2.0-rc.2 与 0.2.1-rc.2 之间字节一致，`dsh.bundle.patch`、locale 与图标元数据在 0.2.0-rc.2 已经可用。
- **Node.js**：`>=22`（`engines.node`）。仅开发脚本与测试需要，插件本身运行在 DSH 内。
- **运行时依赖**：无。`dependencies` 为空，只使用 Node 内置模块，不 import DSH 内部包。

## 技能清单

<!-- skills:count:start -->
共 **32** 个技能，描述取自上游 frontmatter。
<!-- skills:count:end -->

<!-- skills:start -->
| Skill | Description (upstream frontmatter) |
| --- | --- |
| `cesiumjs` | Use when building browser-based 3D globes, 3D Tiles, CZML/time-dynamic data, or glTF models with npm cesium 1.146.0 — Viewer, Cesium3DTileset, Ion token (Cesium.Ion.defaultAccessToken), CESIUM_BASE_URL for Workers/Assets/Widgets, GCJ-02 tile offset, or debugging a black screen after a Vite/Webpack build. |
| `deck-gl` | Use when visualizing large geospatial datasets in the browser with deck.gl 9.4.0 — ScatterplotLayer/GeoJsonLayer, HexagonLayer/ScreenGridLayer aggregation, MVTLayer/TileLayer, @deck.gl/mapbox MapboxOverlay over MapLibre, or debugging blank canvases, stale data props and mismatched @deck.gl/* subpackage versions. |
| `gdal` | Use when processing geospatial raster/vector data via GDAL/OGR CLI — ogr2ogr format conversion (Shapefile/GeoPackage/GeoJSON), gdalwarp reprojection, gdal_translate, gdal_calc.py NDVI, COG, mosaicking, DEM contours, gdalinfo -json checks — or diagnosing "not recognized as a supported file format"; also covers the 3.9+ unified gdal raster / gdal vector CLI. |
| `gdal-api` | Use when programming against GDAL/OGR in C, C++, Python, Java, or .NET — raster/vector I/O, gdal.UseExceptions, OGRSpatialReference transforms, gdal.Translate / gdal.Warp, VRT/COG, or fixing "no driver registered" and UnsatisfiedLinkError; C++ gdal-config, Maven org.gdal:gdal 3.13.0, NuGet MaxRev.Gdal.Core. |
| `geometry-api-java` | Use when working with Esri geometry types (Point, Polyline, Polygon, Envelope) in Java — GeometryEngine, com.esri.geometry:esri-geometry-api:2.2.4, WKT/WKB/GeoJSON/Esri JSON I/O, geodesic distance; also when GeometryEngine has no intersects or WKB method and you need OperatorFactoryLocal, or when 2.3.1 coordinates fail to resolve on Maven Central. Esri Geometry API for Java. |

Esri Geometry API for .NET. |

GeoPandas 1.2.0 extends pandas DataFrames with geometry columns. |
